description: The cable standing inner curl is an isolation exercise targeting the biceps, performed using a cable machine. It emphasizes controlled movement and contraction of the biceps while also engaging the forearms.

name: cable standing lift
instructions: Stand side-on to a low pulley with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Hold the cable handle with both hands next to the hip closest to the machine.
Engage your core and maintain a straight back throughout the exercise.
Keeping your arms straight, exhale and lift the handle diagonally across your body to above your opposite shoulder, rotating your torso.
Pause for a moment at the top, then inhale and slowly lower the cable handle back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
description: The cable standing lift is an exercise targeting the abdominal muscles, especially the obliques and lower back, by using a cable machine to perform a rotational lifting movement.

name: cable standing one arm triceps extension
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, facing a high pulley.
Hold the cable handle with your right hand, palm facing down, elbow bent and the handle at chest level.
Keep your elbow stationary and tucked against your side.
Extend your elbow to push the handle down until your arm is straight beside your thigh.
Pause for a moment at the bottom of the movement, then slowly let the handle return to chest level.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides and perform the exercise with your left arm.
description: The cable standing one arm triceps extension is an isolation exercise that targets the triceps using a cable machine. It is performed standing, one arm at a time, and requires controlled movement to effectively engage the triceps while minimizing shoulder involvement.

name: cable high curl (with rope)
instructions: Attach a rope to the cable machine at the highest setting.
Stand facing the machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the rope with both hands, palms facing each other, arms extended up and forward towards the pulley.
Keep your elbows high and your upper arms still throughout the exercise.
Curl the rope towards your forehead by bending your elbows, squeezing your biceps.
Pause for a moment, then slowly extend your arms back towards the pulley.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The cable standing pulldown (with rope) is an isolation exercise primarily targeting the biceps, performed standing in front of a high pulley with the elbows raised and curling a rope towards the head. It also works the forearms, with the shoulders stabilizing.

name: cable standing rear delt row (with rope)
instructions: Stand facing a cable machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Hold the cable attachment with both hands, palms facing each other, and step back to create tension in the cable.
Keep your back straight and your core engaged.
Pull the cable towards your body, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the peak of the movement, then slowly release the cable back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The cable standing rear delt row (with rope) targets the rear deltoids and upper back muscles using a cable machine and rope attachment. It requires proper form to effectively engage the shoulders and upper back while maintaining core stability.

name: cable standing row (v-bar)
instructions: Stand facing the cable machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the v-bar attachment with a neutral grip, palms facing each other.
Keep your back straight and your core engaged.
Pull the v-bar towards your body, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the peak of the movement, then slowly release the tension and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The cable standing row (v-bar) is a compound exercise that targets the upper back using a cable machine and a v-bar attachment. It also engages the biceps and shoulders as secondary muscles. The movement requires proper posture and core engagement to perform safely and effectively.

name: cable standing shoulder external rotation
instructions: Stand side-on to a pulley set at elbow height, feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent.
Hold the handle with the hand farthest from the machine, elbow bent at 90 degrees and tucked against your side, forearm across your stomach.
Keep your elbow pinned to your side and your shoulder blades pulled back.
Slowly rotate your forearm outward, away from your body, while keeping your elbow in the same position.
Pause for a moment at the end of the movement, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The cable standing shoulder external rotation is an exercise that targets the deltoid muscles, particularly focusing on shoulder stability and external rotation. It also engages the rotator cuff and trapezius muscles, making it effective for improving shoulder health and function.

name: cable standing twist row (v-bar)
instructions: Attach a v-bar attachment to a cable machine at chest height.
Stand facing the cable machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the v-bar with a neutral grip, palms facing each other.
Take a step back to create tension in the cable.
Keep your back straight and core engaged throughout the exercise.
Pull the v-bar towards your torso by retracting your shoulder blades and bending your elbows.
As you pull, twist your torso to one side, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, feeling the contraction in your upper back.
Slowly release the tension and return to the starting position, untwisting your torso.
Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions, alternating the twisting direction with each rep.
description: The cable standing twist row (v-bar) is a compound exercise that targets the upper back while also engaging the biceps and shoulders. It incorporates a twisting motion, which adds a rotational component to the traditional row, enhancing core engagement and coordination.

name: cable straight arm pulldown (with rope)
instructions: Attach a rope to the cable machine at the highest setting.
Stand facing the machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the rope with both hands, palms facing down.
Extend your arms fully in front of you, keeping your elbows slightly bent.
Engage your lats and slowly pull the rope down towards your thighs, keeping your arms straight.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then slowly release the tension and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The cable straight arm pulldown (with rope) is an isolation exercise that targets the latissimus dorsi (lats) using a cable machine and rope attachment. It emphasizes controlled movement and proper form to effectively engage the back muscles while minimizing arm involvement.

name: cable straight arm pulldown
instructions: Attach a straight bar to the high pulley of a cable machine.
Stand facing the machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the bar with an overhand grip, keeping your arms straight and your palms facing down.
Engage your lats and pull the bar down towards your thighs, keeping your arms straight throughout the movement.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then slowly return the bar to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The cable straight arm pulldown is an isolation exercise targeting the latissimus dorsi, performed using a cable machine and a straight bar attachment. It emphasizes keeping the arms straight to maximize lat engagement and minimize biceps involvement.

name: cable straight back seated row
instructions: Sit on the cable row machine with your feet flat on the footrests and your knees slightly bent.
Grasp the cable handles with an overhand grip, palms facing down.
Keep your back straight and lean slightly forward from the hips.
Pull the cable handles towards your body, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the peak of the movement, then slowly release the handles back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The cable straight back seated row is a strength exercise targeting the upper back, performed on a cable row machine. It involves pulling the cable handles towards the body while keeping the back straight, engaging the upper back, biceps, forearms, and shoulders.

name: cable supine reverse fly
instructions: Attach a D-handle to each high pulley and lie face up on a flat bench placed between them.
Grasp the handles with the cables crossed (left hand holds the right cable, right hand the left) and extend your arms straight up over your chest.
Keeping your arms straight, open them out and down to the sides until they are level with the bench.
Pause for a moment, then slowly bring your arms back up over your chest.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The cable supine reverse fly is an isolation exercise targeting the rear deltoids, performed lying face up on a flat bench between two high pulleys with the cables crossed. It emphasizes shoulder strength and stability, with secondary activation of the trapezius and rhomboids.

name: cable triceps pushdown (v-bar)
instructions: Attach a v-bar attachment to the cable machine at the highest setting.
Stand facing the cable machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the v-bar with a neutral grip, palms facing each other and your hands close together.
Keep your elbows close to your sides and your upper arms stationary throughout the exercise.
Engage your triceps and exhale as you push the v-bar down until your arms are fully extended.
Pause for a moment at the bottom of the movement, squeezing your triceps.
Inhale as you slowly return the v-bar to the starting position, maintaining control.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The cable triceps pushdown (v-bar) is an isolation exercise targeting the triceps using a cable machine and a v-bar attachment. It is commonly performed to build strength and muscle definition in the triceps.

name: cable tuck reverse crunch
instructions: Attach an ankle strap to a low pulley and lie face up on a mat with the strap around your feet and your head towards a second low pulley.
Hold the handle from the pulley behind you with both hands beside your head, elbows bent.
Bend your knees and lift your legs up, bringing your knees towards your chest.
At the same time, curl your pelvis up towards your chest, lifting your hips off the ground.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your legs and hips back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The cable tuck reverse crunch is an abdominal exercise performed with a cable machine. It targets the abs and also works the hip flexors. The movement involves curling the pelvis up and bringing the knees toward the chest while lying on your back, using the resistance of the cable for added intensity.

name: cable twist
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, side-on to a pulley set at chest height.
Hold the cable handle with both hands in front of your chest, arms extended.
Engage your core and twist your torso away from the machine, pulling the cable across your body.
Pause for a moment at the end of the movement, feeling the contraction in your abs and obliques.
Slowly return to the starting position, resisting the cable's pull.
Repeat for the desired repetitions, then turn around to work the other side.
Continue until both sides have completed the desired number of repetitions.
description: The cable twist is an exercise targeting the abdominal muscles, particularly the obliques, using a cable machine. It involves twisting the torso against resistance, which helps build core strength and stability.

name: cable twisting pull
instructions: Attach a cable handle to a pulley at knee height and stand facing the machine.
Grasp the handle with your left hand and step away from the machine, extending your arm fully.
Take a wide staggered stance, right foot forward, and bend your torso forward until it is nearly parallel to the floor, right hand resting on your thigh.
Keep your back straight and your core engaged throughout the exercise.
Pull the handle towards your body, rotating your torso to the right as you do so.
Squeeze your back muscles at the end of the movement.
Slowly return to the starting position, keeping tension on the cable.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides and perform with your right hand.
description: The cable twisting pull is an exercise that targets the latissimus dorsi (lats) and incorporates rotational movement, engaging the shoulders and biceps as secondary muscles. It requires a cable machine and involves pulling a handle while rotating the torso, emphasizing both strength and coordination.

name: cable underhand pulldown
instructions: Adjust the cable machine so that the pulldown bar is at a height above your head.
Sit down on the seat and grab the pulldown bar with an underhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Keep your back straight and lean back slightly.
Pull the bar down towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the bottom of the movement, then slowly release the bar back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The cable underhand pulldown is a strength exercise targeting the latissimus dorsi (lats) with secondary emphasis on the biceps and forearms. It involves pulling a cable bar down towards the chest using an underhand grip, which can help improve back strength and muscle definition.

name: cable upright row
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, knees slightly bent, and hold the cable attachment with an overhand grip.
Keep your back straight and your core engaged throughout the exercise.
Pull the cable attachment straight up towards your chin, leading with your elbows.
Pause for a moment at the top, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Slowly lower the cable attachment back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The cable upright row is a strength exercise targeting the deltoids, with secondary emphasis on the traps and biceps. It involves pulling a cable attachment upward towards the chin, leading with the elbows, to engage the shoulder muscles.

name: cable wrist curl
instructions: Attach a straight bar to a low pulley cable machine.
Sit on a bench facing the machine with your feet flat on the floor.
Grasp the bar with an underhand grip, palms facing up, and your hands shoulder-width apart.
Rest your forearms on your thighs, with your wrists hanging off your knees.
Keeping your forearms stationary, exhale and curl your wrists upward as far as possible.
Pause for a moment at the top, then inhale and slowly lower the bar back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The cable wrist curl is an isolation exercise targeting the forearm muscles, particularly the wrist flexors. It is performed using a cable machine and a straight bar, focusing on curling the wrists upward while keeping the forearms stationary.

name: cambered bar lying row
instructions: Set a barbell on the floor under a raised flat bench and lie face down on the bench with your chest supported.
Reach down and grab the barbell with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
With your legs resting on the bench, lift the barbell off the floor by holding it with your arms extended.
Pull the barbell towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Lower the barbell back down to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The cambered bar lying row is a strength exercise targeting the upper back. It is performed by lying face down on a bench and pulling a barbell towards the chest, emphasizing scapular retraction and upper back engagement.

name: chest dip
instructions: Position yourself on parallel bars with your arms fully extended and your body straight.
Lower your body by bending your elbows until your shoulders are below your elbows.
Push yourself back up to the starting position by straightening your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The chest dip is a bodyweight exercise performed on parallel bars that primarily targets the pectoral muscles, with secondary emphasis on the triceps and shoulders. It requires significant upper body strength, stability, and control.

name: chin-ups (narrow parallel grip)
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with a narrow parallel grip, palms facing towards you.
Engage your back muscles and pull your body up towards the bar, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Continue pulling until your chin is above the bar.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: Chin-ups (narrow parallel grip) are a bodyweight exercise targeting the upper back, with significant involvement of the biceps and forearms. The movement requires pulling the body up to a bar using a narrow, parallel grip, emphasizing upper back and arm strength.

name: circles knee stretch
instructions: Stand with your feet together and your hands on your hips.
Bend your knees slightly, keeping your heels on the ground.
Keeping your knees bent, rotate your knees in a circular motion, first clockwise and then counterclockwise.
Perform the movement for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The circles knee stretch is a bodyweight exercise that targets the calves and also engages the hamstrings and quadriceps. It involves standing with feet together and knees bent and rotating the knees in circular motions to improve mobility and flexibility in the lower legs.

name: clock push-up
instructions: Start in a high plank position with your hands directly under your shoulders and your body in a straight line.
Lower your body towards the ground by bending your elbows, then push back up.
Walk your hands one step to the left in an arc, pivoting on your feet and keeping your body straight.
Perform another push-up in the new position.
Keep walking your hands around the arc, doing a push-up at each position, then reverse direction.
Continue for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The clock push-up is a dynamic bodyweight exercise that targets the chest, triceps, shoulders, and core. After each push-up you walk your hands a step around in an arc, pivoting on your feet, so your body moves around like the hand of a clock.

name: close-grip push-up
instructions: Start in a high plank position with your hands placed close together, directly under your shoulders.
Engage your core and lower your body towards the ground, keeping your elbows close to your sides.
Push through your palms to extend your arms and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The close-grip push-up is a bodyweight exercise that primarily targets the triceps, with secondary emphasis on the chest and shoulders. It is performed by placing the hands close together under the shoulders and performing a push-up while keeping the elbows close to the body.

name: cocoons
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your legs straight and your arms extended overhead.
Keep your legs and arms just off the floor and brace your core.
Curl your upper body up while pulling your knees towards your chest, bringing your arms forward to wrap around your knees.
Pause for a moment in the tucked position, then slowly extend your arms and legs back out to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: Cocoons are a bodyweight abdominal exercise that targets the abs, with secondary emphasis on the hip flexors. Starting fully extended on your back, you curl your upper body up while pulling your knees to your chest and wrapping your arms around them, like a cocoon.

name: cross body crunch
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Place your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing outwards.
Engaging your abs, lift your upper body off the ground and twist to bring your right elbow towards your left knee.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your upper body back down to the starting position.
Repeat on the other side, bringing your left elbow towards your right knee.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The cross body crunch is a bodyweight abdominal exercise that targets the abs and obliques. It involves twisting the torso to bring an elbow towards the opposite knee, engaging the core muscles.

name: crunch (hands overhead)
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Extend your arms straight above your head.
Engaging your abs, lift your upper body off the ground, curling forward towards your knees.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your upper body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: A crunch variation where the hands are extended overhead, increasing the challenge to the abdominal muscles and requiring greater core engagement.

name: crunch (on stability ball)
instructions: Sit on the stability ball with your feet flat on the ground and your knees bent at a 90-degree angle.
Lie back on the ball until your lower back is supported and your upper body is parallel to the floor.
Place your hands behind your head or across your chest.
Engage your abs and lift your upper body towards your knees, curling your torso forward.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, then slowly lower your upper body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The crunch on a stability ball is an abdominal exercise that targets the abs while also engaging the hip flexors. The use of a stability ball increases the challenge to balance and core stability compared to a regular floor crunch.

name: crunch (on stability ball, arms straight)
instructions: Sit on the stability ball with your feet flat on the ground and your knees bent at a 90-degree angle.
Lie back on the ball until your lower back is supported and your upper body is parallel to the floor.
Extend your arms straight up towards the ceiling and keep them straight throughout the movement.
Engage your abs and lift your upper body off the ball, curling your shoulders towards your hips.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your upper body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The crunch on a stability ball with arms straight is an abdominal exercise that targets the abs while also engaging the hip flexors. The use of a stability ball increases the challenge to balance and core stability.

name: crunch floor
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Place your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing outwards.
Engage your abs and lift your shoulders off the ground, curling forward towards your knees.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your shoulders back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The crunch floor is a classic abdominal exercise performed lying on your back, focusing on strengthening the abs with minimal equipment.

name: dead bug
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your arms extended towards the ceiling.
Bend your knees and lift your legs off the ground, creating a 90-degree angle at your hips and knees.
Engage your core and lower back to press your lower back into the ground.
Keeping your arms pointing at the ceiling, slowly extend your left leg towards the ground until it hovers just above the floor.
Pause for a moment, then return to the starting position.
Repeat the movement with your right leg.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dead bug is a core stability exercise that targets the abdominal muscles while also engaging the hip flexors and lower back. It is performed lying on your back with the arms pointing to the ceiling, alternating leg extensions while maintaining a stable core.

name: decline crunch
instructions: Lie on a decline bench with your feet secured and your knees bent at a 90-degree angle.
Place your hands behind your head or across your chest.
Engage your abs and lift your upper body towards your knees, curling your torso.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your upper body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The decline crunch is an abdominal exercise performed on a decline bench, targeting the abs and engaging the hip flexors as secondary muscles. It involves curling the torso upward while lying on a downward-sloping surface.

name: decline push-up
instructions: Place your hands on the ground slightly wider than shoulder-width apart, with your feet elevated on a stable surface.
Keep your body in a straight line from head to toe, engaging your core muscles.
Lower your chest towards the ground by bending your elbows, keeping them close to your body.
Push through your palms to extend your arms and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The decline push-up is a bodyweight exercise that targets the pectoral muscles by elevating the feet, increasing the difficulty compared to a standard push-up. It also engages the triceps and shoulders as secondary muscles.

name: decline sit-up
instructions: Lie on a decline bench with your feet secured and your knees bent.
Place your hands behind your head or across your chest.
Engage your abs and lift your upper body off the bench, curling forward towards your knees.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your upper body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The decline sit-up is an abdominal exercise performed on a decline bench, targeting the abs with added resistance from gravity. It also engages the hip flexors and lower back as secondary muscles.

name: diamond push-up
instructions: Start in a high plank position with your hands close together, forming a diamond shape with your thumbs and index fingers.
Keep your body in a straight line from head to toe, engaging your core and glutes.
Lower your chest towards the diamond shape formed by your hands, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push yourself back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The diamond push-up is a bodyweight exercise that primarily targets the triceps, with secondary emphasis on the chest and shoulders. It is performed in a plank position with the hands close together, forming a diamond shape, and requires significant upper body strength and stability.

name: donkey calf raise
instructions: Stand with the balls of your feet on an elevated surface, such as a step or block, facing a flat bench.
Bend forward at the hips until your torso is nearly parallel to the floor and place your hands on the bench, keeping your legs straight.
Raise your heels as high as possible, lifting your body weight onto the balls of your feet.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The donkey calf raise is a bodyweight exercise that targets the calves. It involves bending forward at the hips with your hands on a bench and your toes on an elevated surface, and raising your heels as high as possible.

name: dumbbell alternate biceps curl
instructions: Stand up straight with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward and arms fully extended.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, exhale and curl the weights while contracting your biceps.
Continue to raise the dumbbells until your biceps are fully contracted and the dumbbells are at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
Inhale and slowly begin to lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, alternating arms.
description: The dumbbell alternate biceps curl is a classic arm exercise that targets the biceps and also engages the forearms. It involves curling dumbbells alternately while keeping the upper arms stationary, focusing on controlled movement and muscle contraction.

name: dumbbell alternate side press
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder height.
Press one dumbbell overhead while keeping the other dumbbell at shoulder height.
Lower the pressed dumbbell back to shoulder height while pressing the other dumbbell overhead.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell alternate side press is a shoulder exercise where you press one dumbbell overhead at a time, alternating sides. This movement targets the deltoids and also engages the triceps and core for stability.

name: dumbbell arnold press v. 2
instructions: Sit on a flat bench and hold a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder level, palms facing your body and elbows bent.
Press the dumbbells upward until your arms are fully extended and your palms are facing forward.
Rotate your wrists as you lift, so that your palms end up facing forward at the top of the movement.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell Arnold press v. 2 is a shoulder exercise that involves pressing dumbbells overhead while rotating the wrists, targeting the deltoids and engaging the triceps and upper chest.

name: dumbbell around pullover
instructions: Lie flat on a bench with your head at one end and your feet firmly on the ground.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with your arms extended along your sides, next to your hips.
Keeping your arms straight, slowly sweep the dumbbells out to the sides and around in a wide arc until they are behind your head.
Pause for a moment, then sweep the dumbbells back around the same arc to your hips.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell around pullover is a chest exercise performed lying on a bench, where you sweep a dumbbell in each hand in a wide arc from your hips to behind your head and back. It primarily targets the pectorals, with secondary emphasis on the triceps and latissimus dorsi.

name: dumbbell bench press
instructions: Lie flat on a bench with your feet flat on the ground and your back pressed against the bench.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand, with your palms facing forward and your arms extended above your chest.
Lower the dumbbells slowly to the sides of your chest, keeping your elbows at a 90-degree angle.
Pause for a moment, then push the dumbbells back up to the starting position, fully extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell bench press is a classic upper body strength exercise that targets the pectoral muscles, with secondary emphasis on the triceps and shoulders. It is performed lying on a bench, pressing dumbbells from chest level to full arm extension.

name: dumbbell bench seated press
instructions: Sit on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand, resting on your thighs.
Sit upright and bring the dumbbells to shoulder height, palms facing forward.
Press the dumbbells upward until your arms are fully extended.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell bench seated press is a strength exercise targeting the deltoid muscles of the shoulders, with secondary emphasis on the triceps and chest. It is performed seated on a bench, pressing dumbbells overhead in a controlled manner.

name: dumbbell bench squat
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, arms extended.
Stand facing away from the bench with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Bend at the knees and hips to lower yourself down towards the bench, keeping your chest up and back straight.
Once your glutes touch the bench, push through your heels to stand back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell bench squat is a lower body exercise that targets the glutes, with secondary emphasis on the quadriceps, hamstrings, and calves. It involves squatting down to a bench while holding a dumbbell in each hand, which helps guide depth and form.

name: dumbbell one arm bent-over row
instructions: Place your left knee and left hand on a flat bench, with your right foot on the floor, and hold a dumbbell in your right hand, palm facing your body.
Keep your back straight and roughly parallel to the floor, with your core engaged.
Let the dumbbell hang straight down towards the floor, with your arm fully extended.
Pull the dumbbell up towards your chest, keeping your elbow close to your body and squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
description: The dumbbell one arm bent-over row is a unilateral strength exercise targeting the upper back, with secondary emphasis on the biceps and forearms. It involves hinging at the hips and pulling a dumbbell towards the chest while maintaining a stable, neutral spine.

name: dumbbell bent over row
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, knees slightly bent, and hold a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing your body.
Bend forward at the hips, keeping your back straight and your core engaged.
Let your arms hang straight down towards the floor, with your elbows slightly bent.
Pull the dumbbells up towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbells back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell bent over row is a compound exercise targeting the upper back, performed by hinging at the hips and pulling dumbbells towards the chest while maintaining a straight back.

name: dumbbell biceps curl
instructions: Stand up straight with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward and arms fully extended.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, exhale and curl the weights while contracting your biceps.
Continue to raise the weights until your biceps are fully contracted and the dumbbells are at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
Inhale and slowly begin to lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell biceps curl is a classic strength exercise that targets the biceps and also works the forearms. It involves curling dumbbells from a fully extended arm position to shoulder level, focusing on controlled movement and muscle contraction.

name: dumbbell clean
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand with an overhand grip.
Bend your knees and lower your hips into a squat position, keeping your back straight and chest up.
Explosively extend your hips and knees, driving through your heels.
As you extend, shrug your shoulders and pull the dumbbells up towards your shoulders, keeping them close to your body.
Drop into a squat to catch the dumbbells at shoulder height, palms facing each other, then stand up.
Lower the dumbbells back down to the starting position by reversing the movement.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell clean is a compound exercise that targets the glutes and also works the hamstrings, quadriceps, and calves. It involves explosive movement, coordination, and proper technique to safely lift the dumbbells from the ground to the shoulders.

name: dumbbell close-grip press
instructions: Lie on a flat bench with a dumbbell in each hand, feet flat on the floor.
Press the dumbbells up over your chest and bring them together so they touch.
Turn your palms to face each other, keeping the dumbbells pressed together. This will be your starting position.
As you breathe in, slowly lower the dumbbells together to your chest, keeping your elbows close to your body.
As you exhale, use your triceps to lift the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell close-grip press is an upper arm exercise that primarily targets the triceps, with secondary emphasis on the chest and shoulders. It is performed using dumbbells on a flat bench, focusing on pressing the weights with a close grip to maximize triceps activation.

name: dumbbell concentration curl
instructions: Sit on a bench with your legs spread apart and a dumbbell in one hand, resting your elbow on the inside of your thigh.
Fully extend your arm and hold the dumbbell with an underhand grip.
Keeping your upper arm stationary, exhale and curl the weight up towards your shoulder while contracting your biceps.
Continue to raise the dumbbell until your biceps are fully contracted and the dumbbell is at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
Inhale and slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms.
description: The dumbbell concentration curl is an isolation exercise targeting the biceps, performed while seated with the working arm braced against the inner thigh for strict form.

name: dumbbell cross body hammer curl
instructions: Stand up straight with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing your body.
Keep your elbows close to your torso and your upper arms stationary.
Exhale and curl one dumbbell across your body towards your opposite shoulder while contracting your biceps.
Continue to raise the dumbbell until your biceps is fully contracted and the dumbbell is at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
Inhale and slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position, then repeat with the other arm.
Continue alternating arms for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell cross body hammer curl is an isolation exercise targeting the biceps and forearms, performed by curling dumbbells across the body toward the opposite shoulder.

name: dumbbell cuban press
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs, palms facing you.
Pull the dumbbells up, leading with your elbows, until your elbows are at shoulder height and your forearms hang down.
Keeping your elbows in place, rotate your forearms up until the dumbbells are above your elbows, then press them overhead until your arms are fully extended.
Slowly reverse the movement: lower to the rotated position, rotate your forearms down, and lower the dumbbells to your thighs.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell Cuban press is a shoulder exercise that combines external rotation and pressing to target the deltoids, triceps, and upper back. It is often used to improve shoulder strength and stability, as well as to promote healthy shoulder movement patterns.

name: dumbbell deadlift
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, toes pointing forward.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing your body, arms extended downwards.
Bend at your hips and knees, lowering the dumbbells towards the ground while keeping your back straight.
Push through your heels and extend your hips and knees, lifting the dumbbells back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell deadlift is a compound exercise targeting the glutes, with secondary emphasis on the hamstrings and lower back. It involves lifting dumbbells from the ground by hinging at the hips and extending through the legs and back.

name: dumbbell decline bench press
instructions: Lie down on a decline bench with your feet secured and your head lower than your hips.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand and extend your arms straight up above your chest, palms facing forward.
Lower the dumbbells slowly to the sides of your chest, keeping your elbows at a 90-degree angle.
Push the dumbbells back up to the starting position, fully extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell decline bench press is a chest exercise performed on a decline bench, targeting the lower pectorals. It also engages the triceps and shoulders as secondary muscles. The movement involves pressing dumbbells upward from a declined position, requiring good form and control.

name: dumbbell decline fly
instructions: Lie on a decline bench with your feet secured and your head lower than your hips.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing each other and your arms extended above your chest.
Lower the dumbbells out to the sides in a wide arc until you feel a stretch in your chest.
Pause for a moment, then squeeze your chest muscles to bring the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell decline fly is a chest exercise performed on a decline bench, targeting the lower pectoral muscles. It involves lowering dumbbells out to the sides in a wide arc and then bringing them back together, emphasizing chest muscle stretch and contraction.

name: dumbbell decline hammer press
instructions: Lie on a decline bench with your feet secured and your head lower than your hips.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing each other and your arms extended above your chest.
Lower the dumbbells to the sides of your chest, keeping your elbows slightly bent.
Press the dumbbells back up to the starting position, fully extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell decline hammer press is a chest exercise performed on a decline bench using dumbbells. It targets the lower pectorals and also engages the triceps and shoulders. The hammer grip (palms facing each other) emphasizes the inner chest and triceps while reducing shoulder strain.

name: dumbbell decline shrug v. 2
instructions: Set up a decline bench at a 45-degree angle.
Lie face down on the bench with your chest and stomach resting on it.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing each other and your arms fully extended.
Keeping your arms straight, raise your shoulders as high as possible while squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Hold the contraction for a brief pause, then lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell decline shrug v. 2 targets the trapezius muscles by having the user lie face down on a decline bench and perform a shrugging motion with dumbbells, emphasizing the upper back and shoulders.

name: dumbbell decline shrug
instructions: Set up a decline bench at a 45-degree angle.
Lie face down on the bench with your chest and stomach resting against it.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with your arms fully extended towards the floor.
Keeping your arms straight, raise your shoulders towards your ears as high as possible.
Hold the contraction for a moment, then slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell decline shrug is an isolation exercise targeting the trapezius muscles. It is performed lying face down on a decline bench, holding dumbbells with arms extended, and shrugging the shoulders upward.

name: dumbbell decline triceps extension
instructions: Lie on a decline bench with your head lower than your feet and hold a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing each other.
Extend your arms fully, keeping your elbows close to your head.
Lower the dumbbells slowly behind your head, bending your elbows.
Pause for a moment, then raise the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell decline triceps extension is an isolation exercise targeting the triceps, performed on a decline bench to increase the stretch and activation of the triceps muscles. It also engages the shoulders as secondary muscles.

name: dumbbell decline twist fly
instructions: Lie down on a decline bench with your head lower than your hips.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing each other and your arms extended straight up over your chest.
Lower the dumbbells out to the sides in a wide arc until you feel a stretch in your chest.
As you lower the dumbbells, twist your wrists so that your palms face forward at the bottom of the movement.
Reverse the motion and bring the dumbbells back up to the starting position, squeezing your chest muscles at the top.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell decline twist fly is a chest exercise performed on a decline bench, targeting the pectoral muscles while also engaging the shoulders and triceps. The movement involves lowering dumbbells in a wide arc with a twisting motion, increasing the stretch and contraction of the chest.

name: dumbbell fly
instructions: Lie flat on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing each other.
Extend your arms straight up over your chest, with a slight bend in your elbows.
Keeping a slight bend in your elbows, lower your arms out to the sides in a wide arc until you feel a stretch in your chest.
Pause for a moment, then reverse the movement and bring the dumbbells back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell fly is a chest exercise performed lying on a bench, using dumbbells to stretch and contract the pectoral muscles through a wide arc motion.

name: dumbbell front raise v. 2
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing your thighs.
Keep your back straight and engage your core.
Slowly lift one dumbbell in front of you, with your arm straight, until it is at shoulder level.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower it back down and repeat with the other arm.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell front raise v. 2 is a shoulder exercise that targets the deltoid muscles. It involves lifting dumbbells in front of the body to shoulder height, focusing on controlled movement and proper form.

name: dumbbell front raise
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing your thighs.
Keeping your arms straight, exhale and lift the dumbbells in front of you until they are at shoulder level.
Pause for a moment at the top, then inhale and slowly lower the dumbbells back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell front raise is a shoulder exercise that targets the deltoid muscles, particularly the anterior (front) portion. It also engages the biceps and trapezius as secondary muscles. The movement involves lifting dumbbells in front of the body to shoulder height, focusing on controlled motion and proper form.

name: dumbbell full can lateral raise
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing your body.
Keep your back straight and engage your core.
Raise your arms out to the sides, keeping a slight bend in your elbows, until they are parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your arms back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell full can lateral raise is a shoulder exercise that targets the deltoids and also engages the traps and rotator cuff. It involves raising dumbbells to the sides with a slight bend in the elbows, mimicking the motion of pouring from a can, which helps reduce shoulder impingement risk.

name: dumbbell hammer curl v. 2
instructions: Stand up straight with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing your torso.
Keep your elbows close to your torso and your palms facing each other throughout the movement.
This will be your starting position.
Now, keeping the upper arms stationary, exhale and curl the weights while contracting your biceps.
Continue to raise the weights until your biceps are fully contracted and the dumbbells are at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
Then, inhale and slowly begin to lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell hammer curl v. 2 is a biceps-focused exercise performed with dumbbells, emphasizing the brachialis and forearm muscles. It is performed standing, with palms facing the torso, and involves curling the weights while keeping the upper arms stationary.

name: dumbbell hammer curl
instructions: Stand up straight with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing your torso.
Keep your elbows close to your torso and your palms facing each other throughout the movement.
This will be your starting position.
Now, keeping the upper arms stationary, exhale and curl one dumbbell while contracting your biceps.
Continue to raise it until your biceps is fully contracted and the dumbbell is at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
Then, inhale and slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position and repeat with the other arm.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell hammer curl is a strength exercise targeting the biceps and forearms. It is performed by curling dumbbells with a neutral grip (palms facing each other), which emphasizes the brachialis and brachioradialis muscles.

name: dumbbell incline bench press
instructions: Set up an incline bench at a 45-degree angle.
Sit on the bench with your feet flat on the ground and your back pressed firmly against the bench.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward, and lift them to shoulder height.
Slowly lower the dumbbells to the sides of your chest, keeping your elbows at a 90-degree angle.
Push the dumbbells back up to the starting position, fully extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell incline bench press is a compound upper body exercise that targets the upper portion of the pectoral muscles, with additional emphasis on the shoulders and triceps. It is performed on an incline bench using dumbbells, requiring stability and control throughout the movement.

name: dumbbell incline biceps curl
instructions: Sit on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward, and arms fully extended.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, exhale and curl the weights while contracting your biceps.
Continue to raise the dumbbells until your biceps are fully contracted and the dumbbells are at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
Inhale and slowly begin to lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell incline biceps curl is a strength exercise targeting the biceps, performed on an incline bench to increase the stretch and activation of the biceps muscle. It also engages the forearms as secondary muscles.

name: dumbbell incline fly v. 2
instructions: Set up an incline bench at a 45-degree angle.
Sit on the bench with your back against the pad and feet flat on the ground.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing each other.
Start with your arms extended above your chest and a slight bend in your elbows.
Lower the dumbbells out to the sides in a wide arc until you feel a stretch in your chest, keeping the slight bend in your elbows.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then bring the dumbbells back together over your chest along the same arc.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell incline fly is a chest isolation exercise performed on an incline bench with dumbbells. It targets the upper chest, with the front shoulders assisting, by opening the arms in a wide arc and bringing them back together over the chest.

name: dumbbell incline curl v. 2
instructions: Sit on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward and arms fully extended.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, exhale and curl the weights while contracting your biceps.
Continue to raise the dumbbells until your biceps are fully contracted and the dumbbells are at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
Inhale and slowly begin to lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell incline curl v. 2 is a biceps-focused exercise performed on an incline bench. It isolates the biceps and forearms, requiring controlled movement to maximize muscle engagement.

name: dumbbell incline curl
instructions: Set an incline bench to a 45-degree angle and sit on it with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward.
Let your arms hang straight down from your shoulders, fully extended, with your upper back against the bench.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, exhale and curl one dumbbell while contracting your biceps.
Continue to raise the dumbbell until your biceps is fully contracted and the dumbbell is at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
Inhale and slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position, then curl the other arm.
Alternate arms for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell incline curl is an isolation exercise targeting the biceps. Performed on an incline bench, it emphasizes the stretch and contraction of the biceps by reducing the involvement of the shoulders. This exercise is effective for building biceps strength and size.

name: dumbbell incline fly
instructions: Set an incline bench to a 45-degree angle.
Sit on the bench with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing each other.
Lie back on the bench and press the dumbbells up to the starting position, directly above your chest.
Lower the dumbbells out to the sides in a wide arc until you feel a stretch in your chest.
Pause for a moment, then squeeze your chest muscles to bring the dumbbells back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell incline fly is a chest exercise performed on an incline bench, targeting the upper pectoral muscles. It involves lowering dumbbells out to the sides in a wide arc and then bringing them back together, emphasizing a stretch and contraction of the chest.

name: dumbbell incline hammer curl
instructions: Sit on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing your torso and arms fully extended.
Keep your back against the bench and your feet flat on the floor.
While keeping your upper arms stationary, exhale and curl the weights while contracting your biceps.
Continue to raise the weights until your biceps are fully contracted and the dumbbells are at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
Inhale and slowly begin to lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell incline hammer curl is an upper arm exercise that targets the biceps and also works the forearms. It is performed while sitting on an incline bench, which increases the stretch on the biceps and challenges the muscles through a greater range of motion.

name: dumbbell incline hammer press
instructions: Set an incline bench to a 45-degree angle and sit on it with a dumbbell in each hand, resting on your thighs.
Lie back on the bench and position the dumbbells at shoulder level with your palms facing each other.
Press the dumbbells up and away from your body until your arms are fully extended.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbells back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell incline hammer press is a chest exercise performed on an incline bench using dumbbells, with a neutral grip (palms facing each other). It targets the upper chest (pectorals) and also works the shoulders and triceps.

name: dumbbell incline inner biceps curl
instructions: Sit on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing each other.
Rest your upper arms on the bench, allowing your elbows to hang down and your palms to face forward.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, exhale and curl the weights while contracting your biceps.
Continue to raise the dumbbells until your biceps are fully contracted and the dumbbells are at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
Inhale and slowly begin to lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell incline inner biceps curl is an isolation exercise targeting the biceps, performed on an incline bench to increase the stretch and activation of the muscle. It also engages the forearms as secondary muscles.

name: dumbbell incline one arm lateral raise
instructions: Lie on your side on an incline bench, supported by your lower arm, with a dumbbell in your top hand resting on your hip.
Keep your top arm straight with a slight bend in the elbow and your palm facing down.
Raise the dumbbell in an arc away from your hip until your arm points straight up.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbell back to your hip.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
description: The dumbbell incline one arm lateral raise is a shoulder isolation exercise performed lying on your side on an incline bench. It targets the side deltoid through a long range of motion, from the hip up to vertical.

name: dumbbell incline palm-in press
instructions: Set up an incline bench at a 45-degree angle.
Sit on the bench with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing each other.
Plant your feet firmly on the ground and keep your back straight against the bench.
Start with the dumbbells at shoulder level, elbows bent and palms facing each other.
Press the dumbbells up and away from your body, extending your arms fully.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell incline palm-in press is a chest exercise performed on an incline bench with dumbbells, focusing on the upper pectorals while also engaging the shoulders and triceps. The palms face each other throughout the movement, which can reduce shoulder strain and emphasize the inner chest.

name: dumbbell incline raise
instructions: Sit on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand and lean back against the pad.
Let your arms hang straight down beside the bench, palms facing your body.
Keeping your back against the bench and your arms straight, exhale and raise the dumbbells forward to shoulder height.
Pause for a moment at the top, then inhale and slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell incline raise is a front raise performed seated on an incline bench, targeting the front deltoids. Leaning back lets the arms start hanging behind the torso, which lengthens the range of motion.

name: dumbbell incline rear lateral raise
instructions: Set up an incline bench at a 45-degree angle.
Sit on the bench with your chest against the backrest and hold a dumbbell in each hand.
Extend your arms straight down with your palms facing each other.
Keeping a slight bend in your elbows, raise your arms out to the sides until they are parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your arms back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell incline rear lateral raise targets the rear deltoids with secondary emphasis on the traps and rhomboids. It is performed on an incline bench to isolate the rear shoulder muscles.

name: dumbbell incline row
instructions: Set up an incline bench at a 45-degree angle.
Grab a dumbbell in each hand and sit on the bench with your chest against the incline.
Extend your arms fully, allowing the dumbbells to hang straight down from your shoulders.
Pull the dumbbells up towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell incline row is a strength exercise targeting the upper back, performed on an incline bench with dumbbells. It emphasizes scapular retraction and upper back development while also engaging the biceps and shoulders.

name: dumbbell incline shoulder raise
instructions: Set an incline bench to a 45-degree angle and lie back on it with a dumbbell in each hand.
Press the dumbbells up until your arms are fully extended above your shoulders.
Keeping your elbows locked, exhale and push the dumbbells higher by reaching your shoulders off the bench, spreading your shoulder blades apart.
Pause for a moment at the top, then inhale and let your shoulder blades slowly sink back toward the bench without bending your elbows.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell incline shoulder raise targets the serratus anterior and also works the deltoids and trapezius. It is performed lying back on an incline bench with the arms locked straight up, raising the dumbbells a few inches by pushing the shoulder blades forward.

name: dumbbell incline shrug
instructions: Set an incline bench to a 45-degree angle and sit on it with a dumbbell in each hand.
Place your feet flat on the ground and let your arms hang straight down with your palms facing your body.
Keeping your arms straight, shrug your shoulders up towards your ears as high as possible.
Hold the contraction for a moment, then slowly lower your shoulders back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell incline shrug targets the trapezius muscles by having the lifter sit on an incline bench and perform a shrugging motion with dumbbells. This variation emphasizes the upper traps and can help improve posture and upper back strength.

name: dumbbell incline triceps extension
instructions: Sit on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing inwards.
Extend your arms fully overhead, keeping your elbows close to your head.
Lower the dumbbells behind your head by bending your elbows, keeping your upper arms stationary.
Pause for a moment, then raise the dumbbells back to the starting position by extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell incline triceps extension is an isolation exercise targeting the triceps, performed on an incline bench to increase the stretch and activation of the triceps muscles.

name: dumbbell incline twisted flyes
instructions: Set an incline bench to a 45-degree angle and sit on it with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing each other.
Lie back on the bench and press the dumbbells up to the starting position, directly above your chest, with your arms extended.
Lower the dumbbells out to the sides in a wide arc until you feel a stretch in your chest.
As you lower the dumbbells, rotate your wrists so that your palms face forward at the bottom of the movement.
Reverse the motion and bring the dumbbells back up to the starting position, squeezing your chest muscles together at the top.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell incline twisted flye is a chest exercise performed on an incline bench, targeting the upper pectorals with an added wrist rotation for increased muscle activation.

name: dumbbell iron cross
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Squat down and raise your arms straight in front of you to shoulder height.
Stand up while opening your arms out to the sides at shoulder height until your body forms a T.
Squat back down while bringing your arms back in front of you.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell iron cross is a full-body exercise that combines a squat with a shoulder sweep. You stand up from a squat while opening the dumbbells from in front of you out to the sides until your body forms a T.

name: dumbbell kickback
instructions: Place one knee and the same-side hand on a flat bench, with your other foot on the floor and a dumbbell in your free hand.
Keep your back straight and your torso roughly parallel to the floor.
Bring your upper arm close to your side, with your elbow bent at a 90-degree angle.
Extend your arm straight back, squeezing your triceps at the top of the movement.
Pause for a moment, then slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms.
description: The dumbbell kickback is an isolation exercise targeting the triceps. It involves extending the arm backward while keeping the upper arm stationary, effectively working the triceps and engaging the shoulders as secondary muscles.

name: dumbbell lateral raise
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing your body.
Keep your back straight and engage your core.
Raise your arms out to the sides until they are parallel to the floor, keeping a slight bend in your elbows.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your arms back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell lateral raise is an isolation exercise that targets the deltoid muscles, particularly the lateral (side) head. It is commonly used to build shoulder width and strength.

name: dumbbell lateral to front raise
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing your body.
Keep your back straight and engage your core.
Raise your arms out to the sides until they are parallel to the ground, keeping a slight bend in your elbows.
Keeping them at shoulder height, sweep your arms forward until they are in front of you.
Slowly lower your arms back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell lateral to front raise is a shoulder exercise that targets the deltoids by combining both lateral and front raises in one movement. It also engages the trapezius and biceps as secondary muscles. This exercise helps build shoulder strength and stability.

name: dumbbell lunge
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Take a step forward with your right foot, lowering your body into a lunge position.
Keep your back straight and your chest up as you lower your body.
Push through your right heel to return to the starting position.
Repeat with your left leg.
Alternate legs for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell lunge is a lower body exercise that targets the glutes, quadriceps, hamstrings, and calves. It involves stepping forward into a lunge position while holding dumbbells, then returning to the starting position and alternating legs.

name: dumbbell lying extension (across face)
instructions: Lie flat on a bench with your feet flat on the ground and your head at the end of the bench.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand and extend your arms straight up above your chest.
Keeping one arm extended, bend the other elbow and slowly lower the dumbbell across your face toward the opposite shoulder.
Pause for a moment, then contract your triceps to bring the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Alternate arms for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell lying extension (across face) is an isolation exercise targeting the triceps, performed lying on a bench and lowering one dumbbell at a time across the face toward the opposite shoulder.

name: dumbbell lying elbow press
instructions: Lie flat on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing each other and arms extended straight up over your chest.
Lower the dumbbells towards your shoulders by bending your elbows, keeping your upper arms stationary.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then press the dumbbells back up to the starting position by extending your elbows.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell lying elbow press is an upper arm exercise targeting the triceps, performed while lying on a bench and pressing dumbbells by extending the elbows.

name: dumbbell lying femoral
instructions: Lie face down on a flat bench with your knees at the end of the bench and a dumbbell held securely between your feet.
Bend your knees and bring the dumbbell towards your glutes, keeping your hips pressed into the bench.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell lying femoral exercise targets the hamstrings and also works the glutes. It involves lying face down on a bench with a dumbbell held between your feet and curling your heels towards your glutes.

name: dumbbell lying hammer press
instructions: Lie flat on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing each other and arms extended straight up.
Lower the dumbbells to the sides of your chest, keeping your elbows at a 90-degree angle.
Press the dumbbells back up to the starting position, fully extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell lying hammer press is a chest exercise performed on a bench with dumbbells held in a neutral grip (palms facing each other). It targets the pectorals while also engaging the triceps and shoulders.

name: dumbbell lying one arm deltoid rear
instructions: Lie face down on a flat bench with a dumbbell in one hand, palm facing inwards.
Extend your arm straight down towards the floor, keeping it close to your body.
Raise your arm up and back, letting your elbow bend to about 90 degrees and squeezing your shoulder blade towards your spine.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your arm back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms.
description: The dumbbell lying one arm deltoid rear is an isolation exercise targeting the rear deltoids, performed lying face down on a bench and raising a dumbbell to activate the back of the shoulder.

name: dumbbell lying one arm press v. 2
instructions: Lie flat on a bench with your back supported and feet flat on the ground.
Hold a dumbbell in one hand with your palm facing towards your feet.
Extend your arm straight up towards the ceiling, keeping your elbow slightly bent.
Slowly lower the dumbbell down towards your chest, keeping your elbow close to your body.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push the dumbbell back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the other arm.
description: The dumbbell lying one arm press v. 2 is a unilateral chest exercise performed on a bench, focusing on the pectorals while also engaging the triceps and shoulders. It requires stability and coordination due to the single-arm movement.

name: dumbbell lying one arm press
instructions: Lie flat on a bench with a dumbbell in one hand and your feet flat on the ground.
Hold the dumbbell at shoulder level with your palm facing forward.
Press the dumbbell upward until your arm is fully extended.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the other arm.
description: The dumbbell lying one arm press is a unilateral chest exercise performed on a bench, focusing on the pectorals while also engaging the triceps and shoulders. It challenges stability and coordination due to the single-arm movement.

name: dumbbell lying one arm pronated triceps extension
instructions: Lie flat on a bench with your back and head supported, and your feet flat on the ground.
Hold a dumbbell in one hand with your palm facing down, and extend your arm straight up above your shoulder.
Brace the working arm with your free hand and, keeping your upper arm stationary, slowly lower the dumbbell across your face toward the opposite shoulder by bending your elbow.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then extend your arm back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms.
description: The dumbbell lying one arm pronated triceps extension is an isolation exercise targeting the triceps, performed lying on a bench with a single dumbbell in a pronated (palm down) grip. It emphasizes triceps strength and stability, with some involvement of the shoulders.

name: dumbbell lying one arm rear lateral raise
instructions: Lie face down on a flat bench with a dumbbell in one hand, hanging towards the floor.
Keep your arm straight and lift the dumbbell out to the side, away from your body.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the other arm.
description: The dumbbell lying one arm rear lateral raise is an isolation exercise targeting the rear deltoids, performed lying face down on a bench. It helps develop shoulder strength and stability, with additional engagement of the traps and rhomboids.

name: dumbbell lying one arm supinated triceps extension
instructions: Lie flat on a bench with your back and head supported, and your feet flat on the ground.
Hold a dumbbell in one hand with an underhand grip, and extend your arm straight up above your shoulder.
Brace the working arm with your free hand and, keeping your upper arm stationary, slowly lower the dumbbell across your face toward the opposite shoulder by bending your elbow.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then extend your arm back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms.
description: The dumbbell lying one arm supinated triceps extension is an isolation exercise targeting the triceps, performed lying on a bench with a single dumbbell in an underhand grip.

name: dumbbell lying pronation
instructions: Lie on your side on a flat bench and rest the forearm of your working arm over the edge, holding a dumbbell.
Rotate your palm so it is facing up.
Keeping your upper arm and forearm still, exhale and rotate your palm to face down.
Inhale and slowly rotate the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms.
description: The dumbbell lying pronation is an exercise targeting the forearms, specifically focusing on pronation strength. It is performed lying on your side on a bench with the forearm supported over the edge, rotating a dumbbell from palm up to palm down.

name: dumbbell lying rear lateral raise
instructions: Lie face down on a flat bench with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing each other.
Extend your arms straight down towards the floor, keeping a slight bend in your elbows.
Engaging your shoulder muscles, lift your arms out to the sides until they are parallel to the floor.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your arms back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell lying rear lateral raise is an isolation exercise targeting the rear deltoids, performed lying face down on a bench to minimize momentum and maximize shoulder engagement.

name: dumbbell lying supination
instructions: Lie on your side on a flat bench and rest the forearm of your working arm on the bench, holding a dumbbell.
Start with your palm facing down.
Keeping your upper arm and forearm still, rotate your palm to face up.
Pause for a moment, then slowly rotate the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms.
description: The dumbbell lying supination is an isolation exercise targeting the forearms, specifically the supinator muscles, with the biceps assisting. It is performed lying on your side on a bench, rotating a dumbbell from palm down to palm up with one arm.

name: dumbbell lying supine curl
instructions: Lie flat on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing up and arms fully extended.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, exhale and curl the weights while contracting your biceps.
Continue to raise the dumbbells until your biceps are fully contracted and the dumbbells are at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
Inhale and slowly begin to lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell lying supine curl is an isolation exercise targeting the biceps, performed while lying flat on a bench. It emphasizes strict form and minimizes cheating by stabilizing the body.

name: dumbbell lying triceps extension
instructions: Lie flat on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing each other.
Extend your arms straight up over your chest, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Lower the dumbbells down towards your forehead, bending your elbows.
Pause for a moment, then extend your arms back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell lying triceps extension is an isolation exercise targeting the triceps, performed while lying on a bench and extending the arms with dumbbells.

name: dumbbell neutral grip lying triceps extension
instructions: Lie flat on a bench with your feet flat on the ground and your back pressed against the bench.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with a neutral grip (palms facing each other) and your arms extended straight up over your chest.
Keeping your upper arms still, slowly bend your elbows and lower the dumbbells beside your head.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then extend your elbows to bring the dumbbells back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell neutral grip lying triceps extension is performed on a flat bench with the palms facing each other. It isolates the triceps by bending only at the elbows while the upper arms stay still.

name: dumbbell one arm concentration curl (on stability ball)
instructions: Sit on a stability ball with your feet flat on the ground and your knees bent at a 90-degree angle.
Hold a dumbbell in one hand with your palm facing up and your arm extended down towards the floor.
Rest your elbow on the inside of your thigh, just above the knee.
Keeping your upper arm stationary, exhale and curl the dumbbell up towards your shoulder while contracting your biceps.
