Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, then inhale and slowly lower the dumbbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms and repeat.
description: The dumbbell one arm concentration curl (on stability ball) is an isolation exercise targeting the biceps, performed while seated on a stability ball to increase core engagement and balance requirements.

name: dumbbell one arm kickback
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a dumbbell in your right hand.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight.
Bring your right elbow up to your side, keeping it bent at a 90-degree angle.
Extend your right arm straight back, squeezing your triceps at the top of the movement.
Slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
description: The dumbbell one arm kickback is an isolation exercise targeting the triceps. It is performed by hinging at the hips, keeping the back straight, and extending the arm back while holding a dumbbell.

name: dumbbell one arm lateral raise
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in one hand with your palm facing your body.
Keep your back straight and your core engaged throughout the exercise.
Raise the dumbbell to the side, keeping your arm straight and your palm facing down.
Continue lifting until your arm is parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the other arm.
description: The dumbbell one arm lateral raise is an isolation exercise targeting the deltoid muscles, particularly the lateral (side) head. It also engages the trapezius and triceps as secondary muscles. This exercise helps build shoulder strength and definition, and is commonly used in strength training routines.

name: dumbbell one arm lateral raise with support
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a dumbbell in one hand, with your palm facing your body.
Place your other hand on a stable surface, such as a bench or wall, for support.
Keep your back straight and engage your core.
Raise the dumbbell out to the side, keeping your arm straight and your palm facing down.
Continue lifting until your arm is parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
description: The dumbbell one arm lateral raise with support is an isolation exercise targeting the deltoid muscles of the shoulder. By using a support, it allows for better form and focus on the shoulder muscles, reducing the risk of using momentum or improper technique.

name: dumbbell one arm reverse wrist curl
instructions: Sit on a bench or chair with your feet flat on the ground.
Hold a dumbbell in one hand with an overhand grip, palm facing down.
Rest your forearm on your thigh, with your wrist hanging off the edge.
Slowly lower the dumbbell towards the ground by flexing your wrist.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then slowly curl your wrist back up towards your body.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the other arm.
description: The dumbbell one arm reverse wrist curl targets the forearms and wrist extensors by requiring the lifter to curl a dumbbell upward using only the wrist, with the forearm supported on the thigh. This exercise helps build forearm strength and endurance.

name: dumbbell one arm reverse fly (with support)
instructions: Stand next to an incline bench with your feet flat on the ground and your back straight.
Hold a dumbbell in one hand with your palm facing inwards.
Hinge forward at the hips and place your free hand on the bench for support.
Keep your arm slightly bent and raise it out to the side until it is parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your arm back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms.
description: The dumbbell one arm reverse fly (with support) is an isolation exercise targeting the rear deltoids, with additional activation of the trapezius and rhomboids. It is performed standing and bent forward, with the free hand supported on an incline bench for stability.

name: dumbbell one arm shoulder press v. 2
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a dumbbell in one hand at shoulder level, palm facing forward.
Engage your core and press the dumbbell straight up overhead, fully extending your arm.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbell back to shoulder level.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the other arm.
description: The dumbbell one arm shoulder press v. 2 is a unilateral overhead pressing exercise that targets the deltoid muscles, while also engaging the triceps and upper back for stabilization. This movement helps build shoulder strength and stability, and challenges core engagement due to the single-arm nature of the exercise.

name: dumbbell one arm shoulder press
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder level, palms facing forward.
Press one dumbbell upward until your arm is fully extended overhead, keeping the other at your shoulder.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Repeat with the other arm and keep alternating for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell one arm shoulder press is a unilateral overhead pressing exercise that targets the deltoid muscles, with secondary emphasis on the triceps and upper back. It requires core stability and coordination to maintain balance while pressing with one arm.

name: dumbbell one arm triceps extension (on bench)
instructions: Sit on a bench with your back straight and feet flat on the ground.
Hold a dumbbell in one hand and place your other hand on the bench for support.
Raise the dumbbell overhead, keeping your upper arm close to your head and your elbow pointing forward.
Lower the dumbbell behind your head by bending your elbow, keeping your upper arm stationary.
Extend your arm back up to the starting position, fully straightening your elbow.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms.
description: The dumbbell one arm triceps extension (on bench) is an isolation exercise targeting the triceps, performed while seated on a bench. It involves extending the arm overhead with a dumbbell to work the triceps, with the shoulders acting as a secondary stabilizer.

name: dumbbell one arm upright row
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in one hand with an overhand grip.
Let the dumbbell hang at arm's length in front of your thighs, with your palm facing your body.
Keeping your back straight and your core engaged, exhale and lift the dumbbell straight up towards your chin, leading with your elbow.
Pause for a moment at the top, then inhale and slowly lower the dumbbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the other arm.
description: The dumbbell one arm upright row is a unilateral shoulder exercise that targets the deltoids, with secondary emphasis on the traps and biceps. It involves lifting a dumbbell with one arm in an upright rowing motion.

name: dumbbell one arm wrist curl
instructions: Sit on a bench or chair with your feet flat on the ground.
Hold a dumbbell in one hand with an underhand grip, resting your forearm on your thigh.
Allow your wrist to extend, letting the dumbbell roll down towards your fingers.
Slowly curl your wrist back up, bringing the dumbbell towards your forearm.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the other hand.
description: The dumbbell one arm wrist curl is an isolation exercise targeting the forearm muscles, particularly the wrist flexors. It is performed seated, with the forearm supported and the wrist curling a dumbbell upward.

name: dumbbell over bench neutral wrist curl
instructions: Kneel behind a flat bench and hold a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing each other.
Rest your forearms on the bench, with your hands past the edge.
Keeping your forearms still, exhale and tilt the dumbbells up by bending your wrists toward your thumbs.
Pause for a moment at the top, then inhale and slowly lower the dumbbells back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell over bench neutral wrist curl is an isolation exercise targeting the forearms. It is performed kneeling behind a bench with the forearms resting on it and the hands past the edge, tilting the dumbbells up with a neutral grip using only the wrists.

name: dumbbell over bench one arm neutral wrist curl
instructions: Kneel behind a flat bench with a dumbbell in one hand and rest that forearm on the bench, palm facing inward and hand past the edge.
Keep your forearm still and tilt the dumbbell up by bending your wrist toward your thumb.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms.
description: The dumbbell over bench one arm neutral wrist curl is an isolation exercise targeting the forearms. It is performed kneeling behind a bench with one forearm resting on it, tilting the dumbbell up with a neutral grip using only the wrist.

name: dumbbell over bench one arm wrist curl
instructions: Kneel behind a flat bench and hold a dumbbell in one hand, palm facing up.
Rest your forearm on the bench with your wrist hanging off the edge.
Slowly curl your wrist upwards, bringing the dumbbell towards your forearm.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the other arm.
description: The dumbbell over bench one arm wrist curl is an isolation exercise targeting the forearm muscles. It is performed kneeling behind a bench, with the forearm resting on the bench, palm up, and the wrist curling a dumbbell upward.

name: dumbbell over bench reverse wrist curl
instructions: Kneel behind a flat bench and hold a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing down.
Rest your forearms on the bench, allowing your wrists to hang off the edge.
Slowly curl your wrists upward, bringing the dumbbells towards your body.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbells back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell over bench reverse wrist curl is an isolation exercise targeting the forearms, specifically the wrist extensors. It is performed kneeling behind a bench with the forearms resting on it and the wrists hanging off the edge, curling the dumbbells upward with the backs of the hands facing up.

name: dumbbell over bench wrist curl
instructions: Kneel behind a flat bench with your forearms resting on it and your palms facing up, holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Allow your wrists to hang over the edge of the bench.
Slowly curl your wrists upward, squeezing your forearms at the top of the movement.
Pause for a moment, then slowly lower your wrists back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell over bench wrist curl is an isolation exercise targeting the forearms. It is performed kneeling behind a bench with your forearms resting on it, palms up, and curling your wrists upward with dumbbells.

name: dumbbell preacher hammer curl
instructions: Sit at a preacher bench with a dumbbell in each hand and rest the backs of your upper arms on the pad.
Hold the dumbbells with your palms facing each other and your arms extended.
Keeping your upper arms on the pad, exhale and curl the weights while contracting your biceps.
Continue to raise the weights until your biceps are fully contracted, keeping the neutral grip.
Then, inhale and slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell preacher hammer curl is an isolation exercise targeting the biceps and forearms. It is performed seated at a preacher bench with the upper arms on the pad, curling dumbbells with the palms facing each other.

name: dumbbell sumo squat
instructions: Stand with your feet wider than shoulder-width and toes turned out, holding one dumbbell with both hands between your legs.
Lower your body into a squat by bending your knees and pushing your hips back, keeping your chest up.
Go down until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Push through your heels to stand back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell sumo squat is a lower body exercise performed with a wide stance while holding one dumbbell between the legs. It targets the glutes, quadriceps and inner thighs.

name: dumbbell preacher curl
instructions: Sit on a preacher curl bench with your upper arms resting on the pad and your chest against it.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing up and your arms fully extended.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, exhale and curl the weights while contracting your biceps.
Continue to raise the dumbbells until your biceps are fully contracted and the dumbbells are at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
Inhale and slowly begin to lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell preacher curl is an isolation exercise targeting the biceps, performed on a preacher bench to minimize shoulder involvement and maximize biceps engagement.

name: dumbbell pronate-grip triceps extension
instructions: Lie on a flat bench with your back flat and feet flat on the ground.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing down, and extend your arms straight up over your chest.
Keeping your upper arms still, slowly lower the dumbbells beside your head by bending your elbows.
Pause for a moment, then extend your arms back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell pronate-grip triceps extension is an upper arm exercise that targets the triceps using dumbbells with a pronated (palms-down) grip. It is performed lying on a bench, lowering the dumbbells beside the head by bending only the elbows.

name: dumbbell prone incline curl
instructions: Adjust the bench to a 45-degree incline.
Lie face down on the bench with your chest and stomach resting against it.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing down and your arms fully extended.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, exhale and curl the weights while contracting your biceps.
Continue to raise the weights until your biceps are fully contracted and the dumbbells are at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
Inhale and slowly begin to lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell prone incline curl is an isolation exercise targeting the biceps, performed while lying face down on an incline bench. This position minimizes cheating and emphasizes strict biceps contraction.

name: dumbbell pullover
instructions: Lie flat on a bench with your head at one end and your feet on the floor.
Hold a dumbbell with both hands and extend your arms straight above your chest.
Keeping a slight bend in your elbows, slowly lower the dumbbell behind your head until you feel a stretch in your chest and shoulders.
Pause for a moment, then raise the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell pullover is a chest exercise performed lying on a bench, where you lower a dumbbell behind your head and then bring it back over your chest, targeting the pectorals and also engaging the lats and triceps.

name: dumbbell raise
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs, palms facing your body.
Keep your back straight and engage your core.
Lift the dumbbells straight up close to your body to chest height, leading with your elbows high and out.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your arms back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell raise is a shoulder exercise that targets the deltoids, with secondary emphasis on the traps. It involves pulling the dumbbells up close to the body to chest height, leading with the elbows.

name: dumbbell rear delt row (shoulder)
instructions: Place one knee and the same-side hand on a flat bench, with your other foot on the floor.
Hold a dumbbell in your free hand with your palm facing your body.
Keep your back straight and your torso roughly parallel to the floor.
Let your arm hang straight down towards the floor.
Pull the dumbbell up and back by driving your elbow up, squeezing your shoulder blade.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms.
description: The dumbbell rear delt row (shoulder) is an exercise targeting the rear deltoids, as well as the trapezius and rhomboids. It is a one-arm row performed with one knee and hand supported on a bench.

name: dumbbell rear fly
instructions: Sit on the end of a flat bench with your feet flat and hold a dumbbell in each hand.
Lean forward over your thighs, keeping your back straight.
Let your arms hang down behind your calves, palms facing each other.
Keeping a slight bend in your elbows, lift your arms out to the sides and squeeze your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your arms back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell rear fly is an isolation exercise that targets the rear deltoids, with secondary emphasis on the trapezius and rhomboids. It is performed seated on the end of a bench, leaning forward over the thighs, and lifting dumbbells out to the sides while squeezing the shoulder blades together.

name: dumbbell rear lateral raise (support head)
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a dumbbell in each hand.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight.
Raise your arms out to the sides, keeping a slight bend in your elbows, until they are parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your arms back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell rear lateral raise (support head) is an isolation exercise targeting the rear deltoids, with secondary emphasis on the traps and rhomboids. It involves hinging forward at the hips and raising dumbbells out to the sides, focusing on shoulder stability and control.

name: dumbbell rear lateral raise
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing your body.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight and core engaged.
Raise your arms out to the sides, keeping a slight bend in your elbows, until they are parallel to the floor.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your arms back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell rear lateral raise is an isolation exercise targeting the rear deltoids, with secondary emphasis on the traps and rhomboids. It is performed by hinging at the hips and raising dumbbells out to the sides, focusing on shoulder movement.

name: dumbbell rear lunge
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Take a step backward with your right foot, lowering your body into a lunge position.
Bend your left knee and lower your body until your left thigh is parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment, then push through your left heel to return to the starting position.
Repeat on the other side, stepping back with your left foot.
description: The dumbbell rear lunge is a lower body exercise that targets the glutes, with secondary emphasis on the quadriceps, hamstrings, and calves. It involves stepping backward into a lunge while holding dumbbells, challenging balance and unilateral leg strength.

name: dumbbell reverse grip biceps curl
instructions: Stand up straight with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing down and arms fully extended.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, exhale and curl the weights while contracting your biceps.
Continue to raise the weights until your biceps are fully contracted and the dumbbells are at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
Inhale and slowly begin to lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell reverse grip biceps curl is an exercise targeting the biceps and forearms, performed by curling dumbbells with an overhand grip.

name: dumbbell reverse fly
instructions: Set an incline bench to a low angle and hold a dumbbell in each hand.
Lie face down on the bench with your chest against the pad and your feet on the floor.
Let your arms hang straight down, palms facing each other.
Keeping a slight bend in your elbows, raise your arms out to the sides until they are parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your arms back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell reverse fly is an exercise that targets the rear deltoids, with secondary emphasis on the trapezius and rhomboids. It is performed lying face down on an incline bench and lifting dumbbells out to the sides in a controlled manner.

name: dumbbell reverse preacher curl
instructions: Sit on a preacher bench with your upper arms resting on the pad and your chest against the support.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with an overhand grip, palms facing down.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, exhale and curl the dumbbells as you contract your biceps.
Continue to curl the dumbbells until your biceps are fully contracted and the dumbbells are at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
Inhale and slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell reverse preacher curl is an isolation exercise targeting the biceps and forearms. It is performed seated on a preacher bench, with the upper arms resting on the pad and dumbbells held in an overhand grip. The movement involves curling the dumbbells upward while keeping the upper arms stationary, emphasizing the forearms and the brachialis.

name: dumbbell reverse wrist curl
instructions: Sit on a bench or chair with your feet flat on the ground.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with an overhand grip, palms facing down.
Rest your forearms on your thighs, allowing your wrists to hang off the edge.
Slowly curl your wrists upward, bringing the dumbbells towards your body.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbells back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell reverse wrist curl is an isolation exercise targeting the forearms, specifically the extensor muscles. It is performed seated, with the forearms resting on the thighs and the wrists curling the dumbbells upward using an overhand grip.

name: dumbbell rotation reverse fly
instructions: Hold a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing inwards.
Lie face down on an incline bench with your chest against the pad and your feet on the floor, letting your arms hang down.
Raise your arms out to the sides, keeping a slight bend in your elbows, until they are parallel to the floor.
Rotate your arms so that your palms are facing downwards.
Slowly lower your arms back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell rotation reverse fly is a shoulder exercise that targets the deltoids, with secondary emphasis on the trapezius and rhomboids. It involves lying face down on an incline bench and lifting dumbbells out to the sides with a rotational component.

name: dumbbell seated alternate front raise
instructions: Sit on a bench with your back straight and feet flat on the ground.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing your body and arms extended down by your sides.
Keeping your arms straight, raise one dumbbell in front of you until it is parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat with the other arm.
Alternate between arms for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell seated alternate front raise is a shoulder exercise that targets the deltoids, with secondary emphasis on the trapezius and biceps. It is performed seated, which helps stabilize the body and isolate the shoulder muscles.

name: dumbbell seated alternate press
instructions: Sit on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward.
Raise the dumbbells to shoulder height, with your elbows bent and palms facing forward.
Press one dumbbell up overhead, fully extending your arm.
Lower the dumbbell back down to shoulder height.
Repeat with the other arm.
Continue alternating arms for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell seated alternate press is a shoulder exercise performed while seated, pressing one dumbbell overhead at a time in an alternating fashion. This movement targets the deltoid muscles and also engages the triceps and chest as secondary muscles.

name: dumbbell seated bench extension
instructions: Sit on a bench with your back straight and feet flat on the ground.
Hold a dumbbell with both hands and extend your arms straight up above your head.
Slowly lower the dumbbell behind your head, keeping your elbows close to your ears.
Pause for a moment, then raise the dumbbell back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell seated bench extension is an upper arm exercise targeting the triceps. It involves sitting on a bench, holding a dumbbell overhead with both hands, and lowering it behind the head before extending the arms back up.

name: dumbbell seated biceps curl (on stability ball)
instructions: Sit on a stability ball with your feet flat on the ground and your back straight.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing forward and your arms fully extended.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, exhale and curl the dumbbells while contracting your biceps.
Continue to raise the dumbbells until your biceps are fully contracted and the dumbbells are at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
Inhale and slowly begin to lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell seated biceps curl (on stability ball) is a biceps-focused exercise performed while seated on a stability ball, which adds an element of balance and core engagement. It targets the biceps and also works the forearms as secondary muscles.

name: dumbbell seated curl
instructions: Sit on a bench with your feet flat on the ground and a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward.
Keep your back straight and your elbows close to your torso.
Exhale and curl the dumbbells up towards your shoulders, contracting your biceps.
Pause for a moment at the top, then inhale and slowly lower the dumbbells back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell seated curl is a strength exercise targeting the biceps, performed while seated to minimize body movement and focus on arm isolation.

name: dumbbell seated front raise
instructions: Sit on a bench with your feet flat on the ground and a dumbbell in each hand, resting on your thighs.
Keep your back straight and core engaged.
Raise the dumbbells in front of you, with your palms facing down, until they are at shoulder level.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbells back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell seated front raise is a shoulder exercise that targets the deltoid muscles. It is performed while seated, which helps to isolate the shoulders and minimize momentum, making it a controlled movement for building shoulder strength.

name: dumbbell seated inner biceps curl
instructions: Sit on a bench with your feet flat on the ground and hold a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing up.
Sit back against the backrest and let your arms hang straight down at your sides.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, curl the dumbbells up towards your shoulders by contracting your biceps.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbells back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell seated inner biceps curl targets the biceps and forearms by having the lifter sit on a bench with back support, arms hanging at the sides, and curl dumbbells upward. The back support minimizes momentum, making it an effective strength-building exercise.

name: dumbbell seated kickback
instructions: Sit on a bench with your feet flat on the ground and hold a dumbbell in each hand.
Bend your knees slightly and lean forward from your hips, keeping your back straight.
Bring your upper arms close to your sides and keep your elbows bent at a 90-degree angle.
Extend your arms straight back, squeezing your triceps at the top of the movement.
Pause for a moment, then slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell seated kickback is an isolation exercise targeting the triceps, performed while seated with dumbbells. It requires maintaining a stable posture and proper form to effectively engage the triceps.

name: dumbbell seated lateral raise v. 2
instructions: Sit on a bench with your feet flat on the ground and a dumbbell in each hand, resting on your thighs.
Keep your back straight and core engaged.
Raise the dumbbells to your sides with a slight bend in your elbows, until your arms are parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbells back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell seated lateral raise (version 2) is an isolation exercise targeting the deltoid muscles. It is performed while seated, which helps minimize momentum and focuses the effort on the shoulder muscles. This exercise is commonly used to build shoulder width and strength.

name: dumbbell seated lateral raise
instructions: Sit on a bench with your feet flat on the ground and a dumbbell in each hand, resting on your thighs.
Keep your back straight and core engaged.
Raise the dumbbells to your sides with a slight bend in your elbows, until your arms are parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbells back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell seated lateral raise is an isolation exercise targeting the deltoid muscles of the shoulders. It is performed while seated, which helps minimize momentum and focuses the effort on the shoulder muscles.

name: dumbbell seated neutral wrist curl
instructions: Sit on a bench with your feet flat on the ground and hold a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing each other.
Rest your forearms on your thighs, with your hands past your knees.
Keeping your forearms still, tilt the dumbbells up by bending your wrists toward your thumbs.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbells back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell seated neutral wrist curl targets the biceps and forearms by having the lifter curl dumbbells with a neutral grip while seated, focusing on wrist and forearm strength.

name: dumbbell seated one arm kickback
instructions: Sit on a bench with your feet flat on the ground and hold a dumbbell in one hand.
Bend your torso forward at the waist, keeping your back straight and parallel to the ground.
Extend your arm straight back, keeping your elbow close to your body.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms.
description: The dumbbell seated one arm kickback is an isolation exercise targeting the triceps, performed while seated on a bench. It requires a dumbbell and focuses on extending the arm backward to engage the triceps.

name: dumbbell seated one arm rotate
instructions: Sit on a bench with a dumbbell in one hand and lean forward slightly.
Let your working arm hang straight down beside your leg.
Keeping your arm still, rotate your forearm to turn the dumbbell as far as you can in one direction.
Pause for a moment, then slowly rotate it back the other way.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the other arm.
description: The dumbbell seated one arm rotate is an isolation exercise targeting the forearms. It involves rotating the forearm with the arm hanging straight down, helping to improve forearm strength and mobility.

name: dumbbell seated one leg calf raise
instructions: Sit on a bench or chair with your feet flat on the ground and a dumbbell resting on your right thigh.
Extend your left leg straight out in front of you, keeping your foot flexed.
Place the ball of your right foot on an elevated surface, such as a step or weight plate.
Using your calf muscles, raise your right heel as high as possible.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heel back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.
description: The dumbbell seated one leg calf raise is an isolation exercise targeting the calf muscles, performed while seated with a dumbbell placed on the working thigh. It helps build strength and muscle in the calves, with some engagement of the hamstrings and glutes for stabilization.

name: dumbbell seated palms up wrist curl
instructions: Sit on a bench with your feet flat on the ground and hold a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing up.
Rest your forearms on your thighs, allowing your wrists to hang off the edge.
Slowly curl your wrists upward, squeezing your forearms at the top of the movement.
Pause for a moment, then lower your wrists back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell seated palms up wrist curl is an isolation exercise targeting the forearm muscles, specifically the wrist flexors. It is performed seated, with the forearms resting on the thighs and the wrists curling the dumbbells upward.

name: dumbbell seated preacher curl
instructions: Sit on a preacher curl bench with your feet flat on the floor.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with an underhand grip, resting your upper arms against the preacher pad.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, exhale and curl the dumbbells up towards your shoulders.
Pause for a moment at the top, then inhale and slowly lower the dumbbells back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell seated preacher curl is an isolation exercise targeting the biceps, performed while seated on a preacher bench to minimize momentum and maximize biceps engagement.

name: dumbbell seated reverse grip concentration curl
instructions: Sit on a bench with your feet flat on the ground and hold a dumbbell in one hand, palm facing up.
Rest your elbow on the inside of your thigh, just above the knee.
Keeping your upper arm stationary, exhale and curl the dumbbell towards your shoulder.
Pause for a moment at the top, squeezing your biceps.
Inhale and slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms.
description: The dumbbell seated reverse grip concentration curl is an isolation exercise targeting the biceps, performed while seated with a dumbbell and a reverse (underhand) grip. It emphasizes strict form and muscle contraction.

name: dumbbell seated shoulder press (parallel grip)
instructions: Sit on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing inward.
Raise the dumbbells to shoulder height, elbows bent and palms facing each other.
Press the dumbbells upward until your arms are fully extended overhead.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbells back to shoulder height.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell seated shoulder press (parallel grip) is a strength exercise targeting the deltoids, performed while seated with dumbbells held in a neutral grip. It also engages the triceps and upper back as secondary muscles.

name: dumbbell seated shoulder press
instructions: Sit on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand, resting on your thighs.
Raise the dumbbells to shoulder height, palms facing forward.
Press the dumbbells upward until your arms are fully extended overhead.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbells back to shoulder height.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell seated shoulder press is a strength exercise targeting the deltoid muscles of the shoulders. It is performed while seated, pressing dumbbells overhead to build shoulder and upper arm strength.

name: dumbbell shrug
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing your body.
Keep your arms straight and let the dumbbells hang by your sides.
Raise your shoulders as high as possible, as if you are trying to touch your ears with your shoulders.
Hold the contraction for a second, then slowly lower your shoulders back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell shrug is an isolation exercise that targets the trapezius muscles. It involves lifting the shoulders towards the ears while holding dumbbells, focusing on building strength and size in the upper back.

name: dumbbell side bend
instructions: Stand up straight with your feet shoulder-width apart, hold a dumbbell in one hand, letting it hang down by your side, and place your other hand behind your head.
Keeping your back straight and your core engaged, slowly bend sideways at the waist towards the dumbbell side, lowering the weight along your leg as far as you comfortably can.
Pause for a moment, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides and repeat.
description: The dumbbell side bend is an isolation exercise targeting the oblique muscles and abs. It involves holding a dumbbell in one hand and bending sideways at the waist to work the core.

name: dumbbell side lying one hand raise
instructions: Lie on your side with your legs extended and your head supported by your arm.
Hold a dumbbell in your top hand with your palm facing down.
Keeping your arm straight, raise the dumbbell up to shoulder height.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
description: The dumbbell side lying one hand raise targets the deltoid muscles and is performed lying on your side, lifting a dumbbell with one arm to shoulder height. This exercise isolates the shoulder muscles and helps improve strength and stability.

name: dumbbell single leg calf raise
instructions: Stand on one leg on the floor, with your other foot lifted off the ground.
Hold a dumbbell in one hand at your side.
Raise your heel as high as possible, lifting your body up onto your toes.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heel back down to the floor.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the other leg.
description: The dumbbell single leg calf raise is a unilateral lower leg exercise that targets the calves, performed while holding a dumbbell for added resistance. It challenges balance and strength by isolating one leg at a time.

name: dumbbell single leg split squat
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Take a step forward with one foot and position your feet so that your front foot is flat on the ground and your back foot is elevated on a bench or step.
Lower your body by bending your front knee and hip, keeping your back knee slightly bent and your back heel off the ground.
Continue lowering until your front thigh is parallel to the ground, then push through your front heel to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs and repeat.
description: The dumbbell single leg split squat is a unilateral lower body exercise that targets the quadriceps, with secondary emphasis on the glutes, hamstrings, and calves. It requires balance, coordination, and strength, as one leg is elevated and the movement is performed with added resistance from dumbbells.

name: dumbbell single leg squat
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in one hand at your side.
Extend one leg forward and keep it off the ground throughout the exercise, reaching your free arm forward for balance.
Bend your standing leg and lower your body down as if sitting back into a chair.
Keep your chest up and your back straight.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your heel to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.
description: The dumbbell single leg squat is a challenging lower body exercise that targets the glutes while also engaging the quadriceps, hamstrings, and calves. It requires balance, coordination, and strength, as you perform a squat on one leg while holding a dumbbell for added resistance.

name: dumbbell squat
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Keeping your chest up and core engaged, lower your body down by bending at the knees and hips, as if sitting back into a chair.
Continue lowering until your thighs are parallel to the ground, or as low as you can comfortably go.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your heels to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell squat is a lower body strength exercise that targets the glutes, quadriceps, and hamstrings, while also engaging the calves. It is performed by holding a dumbbell in each hand and squatting down and up with proper form.

name: dumbbell standing alternate overhead press
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder level with your palms facing forward.
Press one dumbbell overhead, fully extending your arm.
Lower the dumbbell back to shoulder level.
Repeat with the other arm.
Continue alternating arms for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell standing alternate overhead press is a shoulder exercise that involves pressing dumbbells overhead one arm at a time while standing. This movement targets the deltoid muscles and also engages the triceps and core for stability.

name: dumbbell standing alternate raise
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing your body.
Keep your back straight and your core engaged.
Raise one dumbbell to the side, keeping your arm straight and your palm facing down.
Continue lifting until your arm is parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Repeat with the other arm.
Alternate between arms for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell standing alternate raise is a shoulder exercise that targets the deltoid muscles by lifting dumbbells alternately to the side, improving shoulder strength and stability.

name: dumbbell standing biceps curl
instructions: Stand up straight with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward and arms fully extended.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, exhale and curl the weights while contracting your biceps.
Continue to raise the dumbbells until your biceps are fully contracted and the dumbbells are at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
Inhale and slowly begin to lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell standing biceps curl is a classic strength exercise that targets the biceps and also engages the forearms. It involves curling dumbbells from a standing position, focusing on controlled movement and muscle contraction.

name: dumbbell standing calf raise
instructions: Stand with the balls of your feet on a low step, heels hanging off, holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Raise your heels as high as possible, using your calves.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels below the step.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell standing calf raise is an exercise that targets the calf muscles by lifting the heels off the ground while holding dumbbells for added resistance.

name: dumbbell standing concentration curl
instructions: Stand with your feet wider than shoulder-width, bend forward at the hips and let the dumbbell hang straight down from one hand, arm fully extended and palm facing inwards.
Place your opposite hand on your thigh for support.
Keeping your upper arm stationary, exhale and curl the dumbbell towards your shoulder by contracting your biceps.
Continue to raise the dumbbell until your biceps are fully contracted and the dumbbell is at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
Inhale and slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms.
description: The dumbbell standing concentration curl is an isolation exercise targeting the biceps, performed standing and bent forward at the hips, using one arm at a time for focused contraction.

name: dumbbell standing front raise above head
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand with an overhand grip.
Keep your arms straight and lift the dumbbells in front of you, raising them above your head.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell standing front raise above head is a shoulder exercise that targets the deltoids by lifting dumbbells from thigh level to above the head in a controlled motion.

name: dumbbell standing kickback
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a dumbbell in each hand.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight.
Extend your arms straight back, squeezing your triceps at the top of the movement.
Pause for a moment, then slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell standing kickback is an isolation exercise targeting the triceps, performed by hinging at the hips and extending the arms backward with dumbbells.

name: dumbbell standing one arm concentration curl
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, bend forward at the hips and hold a dumbbell in one hand with your arm hanging down, palm facing up.
Place your free hand on your thigh for support.
Keeping your upper arm stationary, exhale and curl the dumbbell towards your shoulder by contracting your biceps.
Continue to raise the dumbbell until your biceps are fully contracted and the dumbbell is at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
Inhale and slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms.
description: The dumbbell standing one arm concentration curl is an isolation exercise targeting the biceps, performed while standing and focusing on one arm at a time for increased muscle engagement.

name: dumbbell standing one arm curl (over incline bench)
instructions: Stand behind an incline bench, holding a dumbbell in one hand with your palm facing forward.
Rest the back of your working upper arm over the top of the backrest, with your arm extended.
Keeping your upper arm stationary, exhale and curl the dumbbell towards your shoulder by contracting your biceps.
Pause for a moment at the top, then inhale and slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms.
description: The dumbbell standing one arm curl (over incline bench) is an isolation exercise targeting the biceps, performed standing behind an incline bench and curling a dumbbell with one arm while the upper arm rests over the top of the bench.

name: dumbbell standing one arm extension
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in one hand.
Raise the dumbbell overhead, fully extending your arm.
Keep your upper arm close to your head and perpendicular to the ground.
Slowly lower the dumbbell behind your head, bending your elbow.
Pause for a moment, then raise the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell standing one arm extension is an isolation exercise targeting the triceps. It involves holding a dumbbell overhead with one arm and extending the elbow to lift the weight, focusing on triceps engagement.

name: dumbbell standing one arm palm in press
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in one hand at shoulder height with your palm facing inwards.
Engage your core and keep your back straight.
Press the dumbbell upwards until your arm is fully extended.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the other arm.
description: The dumbbell standing one arm palm in press is a unilateral shoulder exercise that targets the deltoids while also engaging the triceps and core for stabilization. It is performed standing, pressing a dumbbell overhead with one arm at a time, palm facing inward.

name: dumbbell standing one arm reverse curl
instructions: Stand up straight with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a dumbbell in one hand with an overhand grip.
Keep your arm fully extended and close to your body, with your palm facing down.
Slowly curl the dumbbell up towards your shoulder, keeping your upper arm stationary.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the other arm.
description: The dumbbell standing one arm reverse curl targets the biceps and forearms using a dumbbell with an overhand grip, emphasizing the brachialis and forearm extensors.

name: dumbbell standing overhead press
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder level with your palms facing forward.
Press the dumbbells upward until your arms are fully extended overhead.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbells back down to shoulder level.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell standing overhead press is a compound exercise targeting the deltoids, performed by pressing dumbbells overhead from shoulder height while standing.

name: dumbbell standing palms in press
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder level with your palms facing inwards.
Keeping your core engaged and your back straight, press the dumbbells upwards until your arms are fully extended overhead.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell standing palms in press is a shoulder exercise that targets the deltoids, with secondary emphasis on the triceps and chest. It involves pressing dumbbells overhead while keeping the palms facing inward, which can be easier on the shoulder joints compared to a traditional overhead press.

name: dumbbell standing preacher curl
instructions: Stand upright with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward.
Rest the back of your upper arms against the preacher bench or an incline bench, with your elbows slightly bent.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, exhale and curl the weights while contracting your biceps.
Continue to raise the dumbbells until your biceps are fully contracted and the dumbbells are at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
Inhale and slowly begin to lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell standing preacher curl is an isolation exercise targeting the biceps, performed while standing and bracing the upper arms against a preacher or incline bench for strict form.

name: dumbbell standing reverse curl
instructions: Stand up straight with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing your body.

Keeping your upper arms stationary, exhale and curl the weights while contracting your biceps. Continue to raise the weights until your biceps are fully contracted and the dumbbells are at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
Inhale and slowly begin to lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell standing reverse curl is an exercise targeting the biceps and forearms, performed by curling dumbbells with an overhand grip while standing.

name: dumbbell standing triceps extension
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold one dumbbell with both hands.
Raise the dumbbell overhead, keeping your arms straight.
Bend your elbows and lower the dumbbell behind your head, keeping your upper arms stationary.
Extend your arms back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell standing triceps extension is an isolation exercise targeting the triceps, performed by holding one dumbbell overhead with both hands and extending the arms. It also engages the shoulders as secondary muscles.

name: dumbbell step-up
instructions: Stand in front of a bench or step with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing your body.
Place your right foot on the bench or step, ensuring your entire foot is in contact with the surface.
Push through your right heel and lift your body up onto the bench or step, straightening your right leg.
Bring your left foot up onto the bench or step, standing fully upright.
Step back down with your left foot, followed by your right foot, returning to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.
description: The dumbbell step-up is a lower body exercise that targets the glutes, quadriceps, and hamstrings, while also engaging the calves. It involves stepping onto a raised platform while holding dumbbells, which increases resistance and challenges balance and coordination.

name: dumbbell stiff leg deadlift
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand with an overhand grip.
Keeping your back straight and your core engaged, hinge at the hips and lower the dumbbells towards the ground, allowing a slight bend in your knees.
Lower the dumbbells until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings, then squeeze your glutes and push through your heels to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell stiff leg deadlift is a lower body exercise that targets the glutes and hamstrings, with additional activation of the lower back. It involves hinging at the hips while keeping the legs mostly straight, emphasizing a stretch and contraction in the posterior chain.

name: dumbbell straight arm pullover
instructions: Lie flat on a bench with your head at one end and your feet planted firmly on the ground.
Hold a dumbbell with both hands and extend your arms straight above your chest.
Keeping your arms straight, slowly lower the dumbbell behind your head in an arc-like motion.
Pause for a moment, then raise the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell straight arm pullover is a chest exercise that also targets the lats and triceps. It involves lying on a bench and moving a dumbbell in an arc over and behind your head while keeping your arms straight.

name: dumbbell straight leg deadlift
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand with an overhand grip.
Keeping your back straight and your core engaged, hinge at the hips and lower the dumbbells towards the ground, allowing your torso to lean forward.
Continue lowering the dumbbells until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings, keeping your knees slightly bent.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then engage your glutes and hamstrings to lift your torso back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell straight leg deadlift is a strength exercise targeting the glutes, hamstrings, and lower back. It involves hinging at the hips while keeping the back straight and lowering dumbbells toward the ground, then returning to the starting position.

name: dumbbell tate press
instructions: Lie on a flat bench with a dumbbell in each hand and extend your arms straight up above your chest.
Turn your palms to face your feet so the dumbbell ends point toward each other.
Keeping your upper arms still, bend your elbows out to the sides and lower the dumbbells together onto your chest.
Extend your elbows to press the dumbbells back up to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell Tate press is an upper arm exercise primarily targeting the triceps, with secondary involvement of the shoulders. It is performed lying on a flat bench, bending the elbows out to the sides so the dumbbells come down together onto the chest.

name: dumbbell upright row
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand with an overhand grip.
Let the dumbbells hang in front of your thighs, with your arms fully extended.
Keeping your back straight and your core engaged, exhale and lift the dumbbells straight up towards your chin, leading with your elbows.
Pause for a moment at the top, then inhale and slowly lower the dumbbells back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell upright row is a strength exercise targeting the deltoids, with secondary emphasis on the traps and biceps. It involves lifting dumbbells from thigh level to chin height, leading with the elbows.

name: dumbbell w-press
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward.
Raise the dumbbells to shoulder height, elbows bent and palms facing forward.
Press the dumbbells upward until your arms are fully extended overhead.
Lower the dumbbells back to shoulder height.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell W-press is a standing shoulder exercise performed with dumbbells, focusing on the deltoid muscles. It involves pressing the weights overhead from a 'W' position, engaging the shoulders, triceps, and chest.

name: dumbbell zottman curl
instructions: Stand up straight with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing your body.
Keep your elbows close to your torso and rotate your palms to face forward.
Curl the dumbbells up to your shoulders while keeping your upper arms stationary.
At the top of the movement, rotate your wrists so that your palms are facing away from your body.
Slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position, rotating your palms back to facing your body.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell Zottman curl is a biceps exercise that incorporates both a standard curl and a reverse curl, targeting the biceps and forearms. It involves rotating the wrists at the top of the movement to work both muscle groups effectively.

name: elbow-to-knee
instructions: Start by lying flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Place your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing outwards.
Engage your abs and lift your upper body off the ground, bringing your right elbow towards your left knee.
At the same time, bring your left knee towards your right elbow, creating a twisting motion.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your upper body and extend your legs back to the starting position.
Repeat the movement, this time bringing your left elbow towards your right knee and your right knee towards your left elbow.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The elbow-to-knee exercise is a bodyweight movement targeting the abdominal muscles, especially the abs and obliques, through a twisting, crunch-like motion.

name: ez barbell anti gravity press
instructions: Lie face down on an incline bench with your chest on the pad and your feet on the floor, holding the ez barbell with an overhand grip.
Bring the bar in front of your head, elbows bent and pointing out to the sides.
Press the bar forward and up until your arms are fully extended in line with your torso.
Lower the bar back in front of your head and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The EZ barbell anti gravity press is a shoulder exercise performed with an EZ barbell. It targets the deltoids and upper back and also works the triceps. It is performed lying face down on an incline bench, pressing the bar forward and up from in front of the head.

name: ez barbell close-grip curl
instructions: Stand up straight with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold the ez barbell with an underhand grip, hands close together near the center of the bar.
Keep your elbows close to your torso and your upper arms stationary throughout the movement.
Curl the barbell up towards your shoulders, contracting your biceps.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the barbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The EZ barbell close-grip curl is a biceps-focused exercise performed with an EZ barbell using a close, underhand grip. It targets the biceps and also engages the forearms as secondary muscles. The movement involves curling the barbell towards the shoulders while keeping the elbows close to the torso.

name: ez barbell curl
instructions: Stand up straight with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold the ez barbell with an underhand grip, palms facing up.
Keep your elbows close to your torso and your upper arms stationary throughout the movement.
Exhale as you curl the barbell up towards your shoulders, contracting your biceps.
Pause for a moment at the top, then inhale as you slowly lower the barbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The EZ barbell curl is a classic arm exercise that targets the biceps using an EZ curl bar. It is performed standing, with an underhand grip, and involves curling the bar up towards the shoulders while keeping the elbows close to the torso.

name: ez barbell decline close grip face press
instructions: Lie on a decline bench with your head lower than your feet.
Grasp the ez barbell with a close overhand grip.
Extend your arms straight up above your chest, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Lower the barbell towards your forehead by bending your elbows.
Pause for a moment, then press the barbell back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The EZ barbell decline close grip face press is a triceps-focused exercise performed on a decline bench using an EZ barbell. It also engages the chest and shoulders as secondary muscles. The movement requires control and proper form to avoid injury, especially due to the bar path near the face and the decline position.

name: ez barbell incline triceps extension
instructions: Set up an incline bench at a 45-degree angle.
Sit on the bench with your back against the pad and hold the ez barbell with an overhand grip.
Extend your arms fully overhead, keeping your elbows close to your head.
Lower the barbell behind your head by bending your elbows, keeping your upper arms stationary.
Pause for a moment, then extend your arms back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The EZ barbell incline triceps extension is an isolation exercise targeting the triceps, performed on an incline bench using an EZ bar. It requires good form to avoid shoulder strain and to effectively work the triceps.

name: ez barbell jm bench press
instructions: Lie flat on a bench with your feet flat on the ground and your back pressed against the bench.
Grasp the ez barbell with a close overhand grip, hands inside shoulder-width.
Lower the barbell towards your upper chest and chin, keeping your elbows tucked in close to your body.
Push the barbell back up to the starting position, fully extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The EZ Barbell JM Bench Press is a triceps-focused pressing movement performed on a bench using an EZ bar. It combines elements of a close-grip bench press and a triceps extension, targeting the triceps while also engaging the chest and shoulders.

name: ez barbell reverse grip curl
instructions: Stand up straight with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold the ez barbell with an overhand grip, palms facing down.
Keep your elbows close to your torso and your upper arms stationary throughout the exercise.
Curl the barbell upwards by contracting your biceps, while exhaling.
Continue to raise the barbell until your biceps are fully contracted and the barbell is at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
Slowly begin to bring the barbell back to the starting position as you inhale.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The EZ barbell reverse grip curl is an isolation exercise targeting the biceps, with additional activation of the forearms. It is performed using an EZ barbell with an overhand grip, focusing on curling the barbell upwards while keeping the elbows close to the torso.

name: ez barbell reverse grip preacher curl
instructions: Sit on a preacher bench with your chest against the pad and your feet flat on the floor.
Grasp the ez barbell with an overhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart.
Rest your upper arms on the pad, allowing your forearms to hang down.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, exhale and curl the barbell up towards your shoulders.
Pause for a moment at the top, then inhale and slowly lower the barbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The EZ barbell reverse grip preacher curl is an isolation exercise targeting the biceps, with additional activation of the forearms. It is performed seated on a preacher bench, using an EZ barbell with a reverse (overhand) grip.

name: ez barbell seated triceps extension
instructions: Sit on a bench with your back straight and feet flat on the ground.
Hold the ez barbell with an overhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart.
Raise the barbell overhead, fully extending your arms.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, lower the barbell behind your head by bending your elbows.
Pause for a moment, then raise the barbell back to the starting position by extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The EZ barbell seated triceps extension is an isolation exercise targeting the triceps, performed while seated with an EZ barbell. It emphasizes triceps strength and development, with some involvement of the shoulders for stabilization.

name: ez barbell spider curl
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold the ez barbell with an underhand grip, palms facing up.
Rest your upper arms on a preacher bench or stability ball, allowing your elbows to hang down.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, exhale and curl the barbell up towards your shoulders.
Pause for a moment at the top, squeezing your biceps.
Inhale and slowly lower the barbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The EZ barbell spider curl is an isolation exercise targeting the biceps, performed with the upper arms supported on a preacher bench or stability ball to minimize cheating and maximize biceps engagement.

name: finger curls
instructions: Sit on a bench with your feet flat on the ground and hold a barbell with an underhand grip, palms facing up.
Rest your forearms on your thighs, allowing your wrists to hang off the edge.
Slowly curl your fingers towards your palms, squeezing the barbell tightly.
Hold the contraction for a moment, then slowly release your fingers back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: Finger curls are an isolation exercise targeting the forearms, specifically the finger flexors and grip muscles. This movement helps improve grip strength and forearm development.

name: flexion leg sit up (bent knee)
instructions: Lie flat on your back with one leg extended, the other knee bent with the foot flat on the ground.
Extend your arms straight overhead, resting them on the floor.
Engaging your abs, swing your arms forward and lift your upper body off the ground, curling forward until your torso is at about a 45-degree angle.
At the same time, lift the extended leg, bending the knee and bringing it towards your chest while your arms reach forward past it.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your upper body and leg back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The flexion leg sit up (bent knee) is an abdominal exercise performed with body weight. It involves sitting up with the arms reaching forward while bringing one bent knee toward the chest, targeting the abs and hip flexors.

name: flexion leg sit up (straight arm)
instructions: Lie flat on your back with one leg extended, the other knee bent with the foot flat on the ground, and arms straight above your head.
Engaging your abs, lift your upper body off the ground while simultaneously raising the extended leg, keeping it straight, until it points toward the ceiling.
Reach your hands towards the toes of the raised leg as you lift your upper body.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your upper body and leg back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The flexion leg sit up (straight arm) is an abdominal exercise performed with body weight. It involves lying flat with the arms extended overhead and simultaneously lifting the upper body and one straight leg to meet in the middle, targeting the abs and engaging the hip flexors.

name: floor fly (with barbell)
instructions: Place two loaded barbells parallel on the floor, about shoulder-width apart, and get into a push-up position on your toes.
Rest one hand on top of each barbell, arms extended under your shoulders and body in a straight line.
Slowly roll the barbells out to the sides, keeping a slight bend in your elbows.
Lower your chest toward the floor as the bars roll apart until you feel a stretch in your chest.
Pause for a moment, then squeeze your chest muscles to pull the barbells back together to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The floor fly with barbell is a chest exercise performed in a push-up position, with each hand resting on a barbell lying on the floor. Rolling the bars apart and back together stretches and contracts the pectoral muscles against body weight.

name: flutter kicks
instructions: Lie face down on a flat bench with your hips at the end of the bench, legs extended behind you and hands holding the sides of the bench.
Engage your glutes and core and lift your legs to about hip height.
Keeping your legs straight, alternate raising one leg while lowering the other.
Continue this fluttering motion for the desired number of repetitions.
description: Flutter kicks are performed here lying face down on a flat bench, with the legs extended off the end and alternately kicked up and down in a fluttering motion. This movement primarily targets the glutes, with secondary emphasis on the hamstrings and lower back.

name: front plank with twist
instructions: Start in a forearm plank position with your elbows directly under your shoulders and your body in a straight line from head to toe.
Engage your core and glutes to maintain a stable position.
Rotate your torso to the right onto your left forearm, lifting your right arm and extending it towards the ceiling.
Keep your hips and legs stable as you twist.
Hold for a moment, then return to the starting position.
Repeat the twist on the left side.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The front plank with twist is a core exercise that targets the abs and obliques while also engaging the shoulders. It involves rotating the torso while maintaining a plank position, which challenges stability and coordination.

name: gironda sternum chin
instructions: Stand facing a high bar with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Reach up and grab the bar with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Hang from the bar with your arms fully extended and your body straight.
Engage your lats and biceps to pull your chest up towards the bar, leading with your sternum.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower yourself back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The Gironda sternum chin is a challenging bodyweight exercise that targets the lats and requires pulling your chest up to the bar, emphasizing a strong contraction in the upper back. It also engages the biceps, rhomboids, and rear deltoids.

name: gorilla chin
instructions: Stand under a pull-up bar with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the bar with a grip slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Hang from the bar with your arms fully extended and your knees slightly bent.
Engage your core and pull your body up towards the bar while raising your knees to your chest, bringing your chin above the bar.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your body and legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The gorilla chin is a challenging bodyweight exercise that combines a chin-up with a hanging knee raise. It targets the abs while also engaging the lats, forearms and biceps.

name: groin crunch
instructions: Lie flat on your back, bend your knees and bring the soles of your feet together, letting your knees fall out to the sides.
Cross your arms over your chest.
Engaging your abs, curl your head and shoulders off the ground, lifting your upper back towards your knees while your legs stay on the floor.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your upper body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The groin crunch is a bodyweight exercise targeting the abdominal muscles, with the legs held in a butterfly position that stretches the inner thighs. It involves lying on your back and curling the upper body up while the legs stay on the floor.

name: handstand push-up
instructions: Find a wall and face away from it, standing a few feet away.
Place your hands on the ground shoulder-width apart and kick your feet up against the wall, coming into a handstand position.
Bend your elbows and lower your head towards the ground, keeping your body in a straight line.
Push through your hands and extend your arms to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The handstand push-up is a challenging bodyweight exercise that targets the triceps, shoulders, chest, and core. It requires significant upper body strength, balance, and coordination, as well as experience with inversion movements.

name: hanging leg raise
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with your arms fully extended and your palms facing away from you.
Engage your core and lift your knees up in front of you, bending them as they rise.
Continue lifting until your thighs are parallel to the ground or as high as you can comfortably go.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The hanging leg raise is a bodyweight exercise that targets the abdominal muscles and hip flexors. It requires hanging from a pull-up bar and lifting the bent knees up in front of the body, engaging the core throughout the movement.

name: hanging pike
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with your arms fully extended and your palms facing away from you.
Engage your core and lift your legs up towards the bar, keeping them straight.
Continue lifting until your feet reach the bar and your body forms a tight pike.
Hold the position for a moment, then slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The hanging pike is a challenging core exercise performed by hanging from a pull-up bar and lifting the straight legs all the way up to the bar, folding the body into a tight pike, targeting the abdominal muscles and hip flexors.

name: hanging knee tuck hip raise
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with your arms fully extended and your palms facing away from you.
Engage your core, bend your knees and pull them up towards your chest, curling your hips up.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The hanging hip raise is an advanced core exercise that targets the abdominal muscles and hip flexors. Hanging from a pull-up bar, you tuck the knees to the chest and curl the pelvis up, which requires core strength, grip strength, and control.

name: hanging straight leg raise
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with your arms fully extended and your palms facing away from you.
Engage your core and lift one leg up in front of you, keeping it straight while the other leg stays hanging.
Continue lifting until the leg is parallel to the ground or as high as you can comfortably go.
