It targets the triceps and also engages the forearms as secondary muscles. The movement requires control and proper form to avoid injury, especially to the elbows and wrists.

name: cable high pulley overhead tricep extension
instructions: Attach a rope to a high pulley and stand facing away from the machine.
Grasp the rope with both hands and extend your arms overhead.
Keep your elbows close to your head and your upper arms stationary.
Slowly lower the rope behind your head by bending your elbows.
Pause for a moment, then extend your arms back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The cable high pulley overhead tricep extension is an isolation exercise that targets the triceps using a cable machine. It requires the user to extend the arms overhead while keeping the elbows close to the head, focusing on triceps activation.

name: cable one arm tricep pushdown
instructions: Stand facing a cable machine with a single handle attached to the high pulley.
Grasp the handle with one hand using an overhand grip and step back to create tension in the cable.
Position your feet shoulder-width apart and slightly bend your knees.
Keep your back straight and core engaged throughout the exercise.
Start with your elbow bent at about 90 degrees and tucked close to your side.
Keeping your upper arm stationary, exhale and push the handle down until your arm is fully extended.
Pause for a moment, then inhale and slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms.
description: The cable one arm tricep pushdown is an isolation exercise targeting the triceps using a cable machine. It helps build triceps strength and definition, and also engages the forearms as secondary muscles.

name: cable rope high pulley overhead tricep extension
instructions: Attach a rope to a high pulley and adjust the weight accordingly.
Stand facing away from the pulley machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the rope with both hands, palms facing down, and bring your hands above your head.
Keep your upper arms close to your head and perpendicular to the floor.
Slowly lower the rope behind your head by bending your elbows.
Pause for a moment, then extend your arms back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The cable rope high pulley overhead tricep extension is an isolation exercise targeting the triceps, performed using a cable machine with a rope attachment. It emphasizes triceps development and also engages the shoulders for stability.

name: cable rope incline tricep extension
instructions: Attach a rope to a low pulley and place an incline bench in front of it, with the top of the bench facing the machine.
Lie back on the incline bench with your head towards the pulley and your feet flat on the ground.
Grasp the rope behind your head with your elbows bent and pointing up.
Keep your elbows close to your head and your upper arms stationary throughout the exercise.
Extend your arms until they are straight above your head, keeping your upper arms stationary.
Pause for a moment, then slowly bend your elbows to lower the rope back behind your head.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The cable rope incline tricep extension is an isolation exercise targeting the triceps, performed on an incline bench using a rope attachment on a cable machine. It emphasizes triceps development and also engages the shoulders as secondary muscles.

name: cable rope lying on floor tricep extension
instructions: Attach a rope to a cable machine and set it to the lowest position.
Lie on the floor facing up, with your head towards the cable machine.
Hold the rope with both hands, palms facing each other, and extend your arms straight up towards the ceiling.
Keep your upper arms stationary and slowly lower the rope towards your forehead, bending your elbows.
Pause for a moment, then extend your arms back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The cable rope lying on floor tricep extension is an isolation exercise targeting the triceps, performed lying on the floor with a cable machine. It requires proper form to avoid strain on the elbows and shoulders.

name: cable standing reverse grip one arm overhead tricep extension
instructions: Stand facing away from the cable machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Hold the cable handle with an underhand grip and extend your arm overhead, keeping your elbow close to your head.
Keep your upper arm stationary and slowly lower the cable handle behind your head by bending your elbow.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then extend your arm back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms.
description: The cable standing reverse grip one arm overhead tricep extension targets the triceps using a cable machine. It requires you to stand facing away from the machine, extend your arm overhead with an underhand grip, and perform an extension movement to work the triceps.

name: cable two arm tricep kickback
instructions: Stand facing a cable machine with a handle on each low pulley, feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent, and hinge forward at the hips until your torso is nearly parallel to the floor.
Hold a cable handle in each hand with your palms facing inwards, upper arms close to your sides and elbows bent at a 90-degree angle.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, extend your forearms backwards until your arms are fully extended.
Pause for a moment, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The cable two arm tricep kickback is an isolation exercise targeting the triceps using a cable machine. It requires maintaining proper posture and control to effectively engage the triceps while minimizing shoulder involvement.

name: dumbbell lying alternate extension
instructions: Lie flat on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing each other.
Extend your arms straight up over your chest, keeping a slight bend in your elbows.
Lower one dumbbell down towards your head, bending at the elbow, while keeping the other arm extended.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then raise the dumbbell back up to the starting position.
Repeat with the other arm, alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell lying alternate extension is an isolation exercise targeting the triceps. It involves lying on a bench and alternately extending each arm with a dumbbell, focusing on controlled movement and muscle engagement.

name: dumbbell seated bent over alternate kickback
instructions: Sit on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing inwards.
Bend forward at the waist, keeping your back straight and parallel to the ground.
Extend one arm straight back, keeping it close to your body, until your arm is fully extended.
Pause for a moment, then slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Repeat with the other arm.
Continue alternating arms for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell seated bent over alternate kickback is an isolation exercise targeting the triceps. It is performed seated on a bench, bent forward at the waist, and involves extending each arm back alternately while holding dumbbells.

name: dumbbell close grip press
instructions: Lie on a flat bench with a dumbbell in each hand and your feet flat on the ground.
Press the dumbbells up over your chest and bring them together so they touch, palms facing each other. This will be your starting position.
As you breathe in, slowly lower the dumbbells together to your chest, keeping your elbows close to your body.
As you exhale, press the dumbbells back up to the starting position, keeping them together.
After a brief pause at the top, repeat the movement for the prescribed amount of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell close grip press is a strength exercise targeting the triceps, with secondary emphasis on the chest and shoulders. It is performed lying on a flat bench, pressing two dumbbells held together over the chest with a neutral grip.

name: dumbbell forward lunge triceps extension
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Take a step forward with your right foot, lowering your body into a lunge position.
Keep your back straight and your chest up.
Extend your arms straight overhead, keeping your elbows close to your ears.
Lower the dumbbells behind your head by bending your elbows.
Pause for a moment, then straighten your arms to return to the starting position.
Repeat the movement for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs and repeat.
description: The dumbbell forward lunge triceps extension is a compound exercise that combines a lower body lunge with an overhead triceps extension, engaging the triceps, shoulders, core, and legs.

name: dumbbell incline two arm extension
instructions: Sit on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand, resting on your thighs.
Lie back on the bench and lift the dumbbells straight up over your head.
Keeping your upper arms still and elbows pointing up, bend your elbows to lower the dumbbells behind your head.
Pause for a moment, then extend your arms to raise the dumbbells back overhead.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell incline two arm extension is an upper arm exercise targeting the triceps, performed on an incline bench with dumbbells. It also engages the shoulders as secondary muscles.

name: dumbbell kickbacks on exercise ball
instructions: Kneel on the floor and lean forward so your chest and stomach rest on an exercise ball, torso roughly parallel to the floor.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with your palms facing inwards, upper arms close to your sides and elbows bent at a 90-degree angle.
Extend your arms straight back, squeezing your triceps at the top of the movement.
Pause for a moment, then slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: A triceps isolation exercise performed kneeling with the torso resting face down over an exercise ball, which adds an element of balance and core engagement. The movement targets the triceps with secondary involvement from the shoulders and back.

name: dumbbell lying single extension
instructions: Lie flat on a bench holding one dumbbell with both hands, arms fully extended above your chest.
Lower the dumbbell in a controlled manner towards your forehead, keeping your upper arms stationary.
Pause briefly at the bottom of the movement, then extend your arms back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell lying single extension is an isolation exercise targeting the triceps. It is performed lying on a bench, holding a single dumbbell with both hands and extending the arms, focusing on controlled movement and triceps engagement.

name: dumbbell one arm french press on exercise ball
instructions: Lie with your upper back and shoulders on an exercise ball, feet flat on the ground and hips raised so your body forms a bridge.
Hold a dumbbell in one hand with your upper arm pointing up and your elbow bent so the dumbbell is beside your head.
Extend your arm straight up towards the ceiling, keeping your upper arm stationary.
Slowly lower the dumbbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms.
description: The dumbbell one arm French press on an exercise ball targets the triceps while also engaging the core and shoulders due to the instability of the exercise ball. This movement requires balance and coordination in addition to upper arm strength.

name: dumbbell seated bent over triceps extension
instructions: Sit on a bench with your feet flat on the ground and hold a dumbbell in each hand.
Bend forward at the waist, keeping your back straight and your head up.
Extend your arms straight back, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Pause for a moment, then slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell seated bent over triceps extension is an isolation exercise targeting the triceps, performed while seated and bent over, extending the arms backward with dumbbells.

name: dumbbell seated reverse grip one arm overhead tricep extension
instructions: Sit on a bench with your back straight and feet flat on the ground.
Hold a dumbbell with an underhand grip and extend your arm straight up overhead.
Lower the dumbbell behind your head by bending your elbow, keeping your upper arm stationary.
Pause for a moment, then extend your arm back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms.
description: The dumbbell seated reverse grip one arm overhead tricep extension is an isolation exercise targeting the triceps, performed with a single dumbbell using an underhand grip while seated. It emphasizes triceps development and also engages the shoulders for stability.

name: dumbbell standing alternating tricep kickback
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand.
Bend your knees slightly and hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight.
Extend your arms straight back, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat with the other arm, alternating sides with each repetition.
description: The dumbbell standing alternating tricep kickback is an isolation exercise targeting the triceps, performed while standing and alternating arms. It also engages the shoulders as secondary muscles.

name: dumbbell standing bent over one arm triceps extension
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a dumbbell in one hand.
Bend forward at the waist, keeping your back straight and parallel to the ground.
Extend your arm straight back, keeping your elbow close to your body.
Slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms.
description: The dumbbell standing bent over one arm triceps extension is an isolation exercise targeting the triceps, performed while bent over and extending the arm behind the body.

name: dumbbell standing bent over two arm triceps extension
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a dumbbell in each hand.
Bend forward at the waist, keeping your back straight and your knees slightly bent.
Extend your arms straight back, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Slowly lower the dumbbells back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell standing bent over two arm triceps extension is an exercise targeting the triceps, performed by bending forward at the waist and extending the arms backward with dumbbells.

name: dumbbell tricep kickback with stork stance
instructions: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand and lift one foot off the floor behind you, balancing on the other leg.
Hinge forward at the hips with a slight bend in your standing knee, keeping your back straight.
Bring your elbows up to your sides, keeping them bent at a 90-degree angle.
Extend both arms straight back, squeezing your triceps.
Pause for a moment, then slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch the standing leg.
description: The dumbbell tricep kickback with stork stance is a variation of the traditional tricep kickback that incorporates a balance challenge by having the exerciser stand on one leg (stork stance) while performing the movement. This targets the triceps while also engaging the core and stabilizing muscles.

name: dumbbell twisting bench press
instructions: Lie flat on a bench with your feet flat on the ground and your back pressed against the bench.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with an overhand grip, palms facing away from you.
Extend your arms straight up over your chest, keeping a slight bend in your elbows.
Lower the dumbbells down towards your chest, keeping your elbows close to your body.
As you lower the dumbbells, twist your wrists so that your palms face towards you at the bottom of the movement.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then reverse the movement by pressing the dumbbells back up to the starting position.
As you press the dumbbells up, twist your wrists back to the starting position with palms facing away from you.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell twisting bench press is a variation of the standard dumbbell bench press that incorporates a wrist twist to further engage the triceps, chest, and shoulders. This exercise requires coordination and control to safely twist the wrists during the pressing motion.

name: exercise ball dip
instructions: Sit on the floor in front of a stability ball with your legs extended.
Place your hands on top of the ball behind you, fingers pointing forward.
Engage your triceps and push through your hands to lift your hips off the floor, straightening your arms.
Lower your body back down towards the floor by bending your elbows, keeping them close to your sides.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The exercise ball dip is a triceps-focused movement performed with your hands on a stability ball behind you. It challenges the triceps, chest, and shoulders while also requiring balance and core engagement due to the unstable surface.

name: exercise ball seated triceps stretch
instructions: Sit on a stability ball with your feet flat on the ground and your back straight.
Raise one arm overhead and bend the elbow so your hand reaches down behind your head.
With your other hand, gently press the bent elbow back and down, keeping your upper arm close to your ear.
Hold the stretch for a few seconds, then return to the starting position.
Repeat with the other arm.
description: The exercise ball seated triceps stretch is a flexibility movement performed while seated on a stability ball, focusing on stretching the triceps and shoulders.

name: exercise ball supine triceps extension
instructions: Lie with your upper back and shoulders on an exercise ball, feet flat on the ground and hips raised so your body forms a bridge.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand and extend your arms straight up towards the ceiling.
Slowly lower the dumbbells towards your head by bending your elbows, keeping your upper arms stationary.
Pause for a moment, then raise the dumbbells back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The exercise ball supine triceps extension is a strength exercise targeting the triceps, performed lying with your upper back on an exercise ball and using dumbbells. It also engages the shoulders and requires core stability to maintain balance on the ball.

name: ez bar french press on exercise ball
instructions: Sit on an exercise ball and hold an EZ barbell with an overhand grip.
Extend your arms straight up, keeping your elbows close to your head.
Slowly lower the barbell behind your head by bending your elbows.
Pause for a moment, then extend your arms back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The EZ bar French press on an exercise ball is a triceps-focused exercise performed while seated on an unstable surface, which also engages the core and shoulders for stabilization. It involves lowering an EZ barbell behind the head and pressing it back up, targeting the triceps.

name: ez bar lying close grip triceps extension behind head
instructions: Lie flat on a bench with your feet flat on the ground and your head at the end of the bench.
Hold the ez barbell with a close grip, palms facing up, and extend your arms straight up over your chest.
Keeping your upper arms stationary, slowly lower the barbell behind your head by bending your elbows.
Pause for a moment, then extend your arms back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The EZ bar lying close grip triceps extension behind head is an isolation exercise targeting the triceps, performed lying on a bench with a close grip on an EZ bar. It requires control and proper form to avoid shoulder strain and maximize triceps engagement.

name: ez bar standing french press
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold the ez barbell with an overhand grip.
Raise the barbell above your head, fully extending your arms.
Keeping your upper arms close to your head, slowly lower the barbell behind your head by bending your elbows.
Pause for a moment, then extend your arms back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The EZ bar standing French press is an isolation exercise targeting the triceps, performed while standing and using an EZ barbell. It involves extending the arms overhead and lowering the bar behind the head, emphasizing triceps engagement.

name: medicine ball supine chest throw
instructions: Lie flat on your back on the floor with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Hold the medicine ball with both hands, extending your arms straight up above your chest.
Lower the medicine ball towards your chest, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Explosively push the medicine ball upwards, extending your arms fully and throwing the ball as high as possible.
Catch the medicine ball and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The medicine ball supine chest throw is an explosive upper body exercise that targets the triceps, chest, and shoulders. It involves lying on your back and throwing a medicine ball upward, emphasizing power and speed.

name: barbell pin presses
instructions: Place a flat bench inside a power rack and set the safety pins so the barbell rests just above your chest.
Lie on the bench under the barbell with your feet flat on the ground.
Grip the barbell with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Press the barbell off the pins until your arms are fully extended above your chest.
Lower the barbell back down until it rests on the pins, keeping your elbows tucked in close to your body.
Pause for a moment with the barbell on the pins.
Push the barbell back up to the starting position, fully extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: Barbell pin presses are a strength exercise targeting the triceps, performed by pressing a barbell from a set height on a power rack. This movement emphasizes lockout strength and triceps development.

name: smith machine incline tricep extension
instructions: Adjust the seat of the smith machine so that the bar is at shoulder height.
Sit on the bench with your back against the pad and your feet flat on the ground.
Grasp the bar with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Extend your arms fully, lifting the bar off the rack and holding it directly above your chest.
Lower the bar slowly towards your forehead, keeping your elbows close to your head.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push the bar back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The smith machine incline tricep extension is an isolation exercise that targets the triceps using a smith machine and an incline bench. It involves extending the arms to work the triceps, with some involvement of the shoulders for stabilization.

name: three bench dip
instructions: Place two benches parallel to each other and a third bench in front of them; stand between the two parallel benches.
Place one hand on each parallel bench beside your hips, fingers pointing forward, and support your weight with your arms.
Place your heels on the third bench in front of you with your legs extended.
Bend your elbows and lower your body until your upper arms are parallel to the ground.
Push yourself back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The three bench dip is a bodyweight exercise targeting the triceps, performed with one hand on each of two parallel benches and the feet on a third bench, allowing a deeper range of motion than a standard bench dip.

name: weighted three bench dips
instructions: Set two benches parallel to each other and a third bench in front; place one hand on each parallel bench beside your hips, fingers pointing forward.
Put your heels on the third bench with your legs extended, have a weight plate placed on your thighs, and support your weight with your arms.
Lower your body between the benches by bending your elbows, keeping your torso upright.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push yourself back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The weighted three bench dips is a triceps-focused exercise that involves supporting your body weight between three benches while adding extra resistance. It targets the triceps and also works the chest and shoulders. This movement requires significant upper body strength, stability, and proper form to avoid injury.

name: weighted tricep dips
instructions: Attach a weight to a dip belt around your waist and grip the parallel bars of a dip station.
Push yourself up until your arms are straight and your body hangs between the bars, legs off the floor.
Keep your torso upright and your elbows close to your body.
Lower your body by bending your elbows until your upper arms are parallel to the floor.
Push yourself back up to the starting position by straightening your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: Weighted tricep dips are a challenging upper body exercise that primarily targets the triceps, with additional activation of the chest and shoulders. Adding weight increases the intensity and requires greater strength and stability compared to bodyweight dips.

name: barbell single leg deadlift
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart, holding a barbell in front of your thighs with an overhand grip.
Shift your weight onto your left foot and lift your right foot slightly off the ground.
Hinge forward at the hips, keeping your back straight and your right leg extended behind you for balance.
Lower the barbell towards the ground, keeping it close to your body and your left leg slightly bent.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then engage your glutes and hamstrings to lift your torso back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
description: The barbell single leg deadlift is a unilateral lower body exercise that targets the glutes, with secondary emphasis on the hamstrings and lower back. It challenges balance, coordination, and strength by requiring you to hinge at the hips on one leg while holding a barbell.

name: dumbbell single leg deadlift
instructions: Stand with your feet hip-width apart, holding a dumbbell in your right hand.
Shift your weight onto your left leg and lift your right foot slightly off the ground.
Keeping your back straight, hinge forward at the hips and lower the dumbbell towards the ground.
At the same time, extend your right leg straight behind you, maintaining a slight bend in your left knee.
Lower the dumbbell until your torso and right leg are parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment, then engage your glutes and hamstrings to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
description: The dumbbell single leg deadlift is a unilateral lower body exercise that targets the glutes, hamstrings, and lower back. It challenges balance, coordination, and strength by requiring you to stabilize on one leg while hinging at the hips and lifting a dumbbell.

name: assisted sit-up
instructions: Sit on the edge of a bench or have someone hold your feet down.
Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Place your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing outwards.
Engaging your abs, slowly lift your upper body off the ground, curling forward until your torso is at a 45-degree angle.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your upper body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The assisted sit-up is a core exercise that targets the abdominal muscles with support, making it easier to perform than a standard sit-up. Assistance can come from a bench, partner, or anchored feet, reducing the strength and coordination required.

name: single leg squat (pistol) male
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and arms extended in front of you.
Lift your right foot off the ground and extend it forward.
Slowly lower your body down by bending your left knee and pushing your hips back.
Keep your chest up and your back straight as you lower yourself down.
Lower until your left thigh is parallel to the ground, or as low as you can comfortably go.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your left heel to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.
description: The single leg squat (pistol squat) is a challenging lower body exercise that targets the glutes, quadriceps, hamstrings, and calves. It requires significant strength, balance, and mobility to perform correctly, making it suitable for advanced practitioners.

name: dumbbell goblet squat
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell vertically against your chest with both hands.
Keeping your chest up and core engaged, lower your body down into a squat position by pushing your hips back and bending your knees.
Continue lowering until your thighs are parallel to the ground, or as low as you can comfortably go.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your heels to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell goblet squat is a lower body exercise that targets the quadriceps while also engaging the glutes, hamstrings, and calves. It is performed by holding a dumbbell close to the chest and squatting down, making it a great movement for building strength and improving squat technique.

name: hanging oblique knee raise
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with your arms fully extended and your palms facing away from you.
Engage your core and lift your knees towards your chest, twisting your torso to the side as you do so.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat on the other side, twisting your torso in the opposite direction.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The hanging oblique knee raise is a core exercise performed by hanging from a pull-up bar and raising the knees towards the chest while twisting the torso to target the abs and obliques.

name: shoulder grip pull-up
instructions: Grab the pull-up bar with a shoulder-width grip, palms facing away from you.
Hang freely with your arms fully extended.
Engage your back muscles and pull your body up towards the bar until your chin is above the bar.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The shoulder grip pull-up is a bodyweight exercise targeting the latissimus dorsi (lats) and also engaging the biceps and forearms. It requires the individual to pull their body up to a bar using a shoulder-width, overhand grip.

name: hanging leg hip raise
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with your arms fully extended and your palms facing away from you.
Engage your core and lift your legs up by flexing your hips and knees until your thighs are parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The hanging leg hip raise is a bodyweight exercise that targets the abdominal muscles by requiring you to hang from a pull-up bar and lift your legs, engaging your core and hip flexors.

name: dumbbell upright row (back pov)
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand with an overhand grip.
Let the dumbbells hang in front of your thighs, with your arms fully extended and your palms facing your body.
Keeping your back straight and your core engaged, exhale and lift the dumbbells straight up towards your chin, leading with your elbows.
Continue lifting until the dumbbells are at shoulder height, with your elbows pointing out to the sides.
Pause for a moment at the top, then inhale and slowly lower the dumbbells back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell upright row (back pov) is a strength exercise targeting the deltoids, with secondary emphasis on the traps and biceps. It involves lifting dumbbells from thigh level to shoulder height, leading with the elbows.

name: self assisted inverse leg curl
instructions: Kneel on a padded step or mat and anchor your ankles under a strap or secure pad behind you.
Keep your body straight from knees to head, hips extended, hands in front of your chest.
Slowly lower your torso forward toward the floor, resisting with your hamstrings as long as you can.
Catch yourself with your hands on the floor at the bottom.
Give a light push with your hands and pull with your hamstrings to return to the upright kneeling position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The self assisted inverse leg curl is a kneeling Nordic hamstring curl: with the ankles anchored, you lower your straight body toward the floor, catch yourself with your hands and push back up. It primarily works the hamstrings, with secondary emphasis on the glutes and calves.

name: weighted triceps dip on high parallel bars
instructions: Position yourself between two parallel bars with your hands gripping the bars and your arms fully extended.
Bend your elbows and lower your body until your upper arms are parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment, then push through your palms to straighten your arms and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The weighted triceps dip on high parallel bars is an advanced upper body exercise that primarily targets the triceps, while also engaging the chest and shoulders. The addition of weight increases the strength and stability demands, making it suitable for experienced lifters.

name: bodyweight side lying biceps curl
instructions: Lie on your side with your legs extended and your head supported by your arm.
Hold your upper arm against your side and bend your elbow to curl your forearm towards your shoulder.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your forearm back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The bodyweight side lying biceps curl is a biceps-focused exercise performed lying on your side, using only your body weight for resistance. It primarily targets the biceps and also engages the forearms.

name: biceps leg concentration curl
instructions: Sit on a bench with your back straight and one foot flat on the floor.
Lift the other leg and hold it under the ankle with one hand, palm up, arm extended.
Keeping your upper arm still, curl your hand toward your shoulder, lifting the leg while it resists slightly.
Pause at the top, then slowly lower the leg back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
description: The biceps leg concentration curl is an isolation exercise targeting the biceps, performed while seated and using the leg for support. It emphasizes strict form and muscle contraction.

name: bodyweight kneeling triceps extension
instructions: Kneel on a mat and place your forearms on the floor in front of you, elbows under your shoulders.
Keep your body in a straight line from knees to head and brace your core.
Press through your palms and extend your elbows to lift your forearms off the floor until your arms are straight.
Pause at the top, squeezing your triceps.
Slowly bend your elbows to lower back onto your forearms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The bodyweight kneeling triceps extension targets the triceps: from a kneeling position on your forearms, you extend your elbows to press up onto your hands and then lower back to your forearms.

name: elbow lift - reverse push-up
instructions: Lie on your back with your legs extended and your elbows bent at your sides, fists pointing up.
Keep your core engaged and your neck neutral.
Drive your elbows into the floor to lift your chest and upper back, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The elbow lift - reverse push-up targets the upper back: lying face up, you press your elbows into the floor to lift your chest and upper back, squeezing the shoulder blades together.

name: one arm towel row
instructions: Anchor a towel securely at about hip height on a wall or post and hold its end with one hand.
Face the anchor, sit back into a low squat and lean back until your arm is fully extended.
Keep your back straight and your core engaged.
Pull your body toward the anchor by driving your elbow back and squeezing your shoulder blade.
Slowly extend your arm to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms.
description: The one arm towel row is a bodyweight exercise targeting the upper back: holding a towel anchored to a wall, you lean back in a low squat and row your body toward the anchor with one arm.

name: side bridge hip abduction
instructions: Lie on your side with your legs extended and stacked on top of each other.
Prop yourself up on your forearm, keeping your elbow directly below your shoulder.
Engage your core and lift your hips off the ground, creating a straight line from your head to your feet.
While keeping your core engaged, lift your top leg as high as possible without rotating your hips.
Pause for a moment at the top, then lower your leg back down.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
description: The side bridge hip abduction is a bodyweight exercise that targets the hip abductors, glutes, and obliques. It involves holding a side plank position while lifting the top leg, challenging both strength and stability.

name: side plank hip adduction
instructions: Lie on your side next to a bench and rest the inside of your top leg on the bench.
Place your forearm on the floor under your shoulder.
Lift your hips so your body forms a straight line.
Raise your bottom leg up toward the bench, squeezing the inner thighs.
Slowly lower the bottom leg back down while keeping the hips up.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
description: The side plank hip adduction (Copenhagen plank) targets the adductors while engaging the obliques: in a side plank with the top leg resting on a bench, you lift the bottom leg up to meet the bench.

name: farmers walk
instructions: Stand up straight with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing your sides.
Keep your back straight and your shoulders back.
Take small, controlled steps forward, maintaining an upright posture.
Continue walking for the desired distance or time.
To finish, stop walking and carefully lower the dumbbells to your sides.
description: The farmer's walk is a functional strength exercise where you walk while holding a dumbbell in each hand, engaging the quads, calves, forearms, and core. It improves grip strength, core stability, and overall conditioning.

name: weighted front plank
instructions: Start by lying face down on the floor.
Place your forearms on the ground, with your elbows directly under your shoulders.
Extend your legs straight out behind you, with your toes on the ground.
Engage your core and lift your body off the ground, balancing on your forearms and toes.
Keep your body in a straight line from your head to your heels.
Hold this position for the desired amount of time.
Lower your body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The weighted front plank is a core stability exercise that increases the challenge of the traditional plank by adding external weight, requiring greater strength and endurance from the abdominal muscles, shoulders, and lower back.

name: dumbbell cuban press v. 2
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand in front of your thighs, palms facing you.
Pull the dumbbells up in an upright row until your elbows are at shoulder height.
Keeping your elbows in place, rotate your forearms up until the dumbbells are above your elbows, palms facing forward.
Press the dumbbells overhead until your arms are fully extended.
Reverse the sequence to return to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell Cuban press v. 2 is a shoulder exercise that targets the deltoids while also engaging the triceps and upper back. It involves a combination of pressing and rotational movement, making it effective for building strength and stability in the shoulder joint.

name: dumbbell arnold press
instructions: Sit on a bench with back support and hold a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder level, palms facing your body and elbows bent.
Press the dumbbells upward until your arms are fully extended and your palms are facing forward.
Rotate your wrists as you lift, so that your palms are facing forward at the top of the movement.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell Arnold press is a shoulder exercise that targets the deltoids while also engaging the triceps and upper chest. It involves a rotational movement as you press the dumbbells overhead, increasing the range of motion and muscle activation compared to a standard shoulder press.

name: stationary bike run v. 3
instructions: Adjust the seat height and position to ensure proper alignment.
Place your feet on the pedals and secure them with the straps if available.
Rise out of the saddle and start pedaling standing, at a comfortable pace.
Maintain a steady rhythm and increase the resistance as desired.
Engage your core muscles to maintain stability and proper posture.
Continue pedaling for the desired duration of your workout.
Gradually decrease the resistance and slow down before coming to a complete stop.
Stretch your legs and cool down after the workout.
description: The stationary bike run v. 3 is a cardiovascular exercise performed on a stationary bike. It primarily targets the cardiovascular system and also engages the quadriceps, hamstrings, and calves. The exercise involves pedaling at a steady rhythm, adjusting resistance as needed, and maintaining proper posture throughout the workout.

name: hands bike
instructions: Adjust the seat height and handlebar position to a comfortable level.
Stand at the ergometer with your feet flat on the platform, knees slightly bent and back straight.
Grasp the handles with your hands and position your arms at a 90-degree angle.
Start pedaling with your hands, pushing and pulling the handles in a controlled motion.
Continue pedaling for the desired duration or number of repetitions.
description: The hands bike (upper body ergometer) is a cardiovascular exercise that targets the pectorals, triceps, and shoulders by requiring the user to pedal with their hands, simulating a cycling motion for the upper body.

name: walk elliptical cross trainer
instructions: Adjust the resistance level and incline of the elliptical machine to your desired settings.
Step onto the pedals of the machine and grip the handles lightly.
Begin by pushing down with your feet and pulling the handles towards your body.
Continue this motion, alternating between pushing and pulling, to simulate a walking or running motion.
Maintain a steady pace and keep your core engaged throughout the exercise.
Continue for the desired duration of your cardio workout.
Gradually decrease the intensity and speed of the machine before stepping off.
description: The walk elliptical cross trainer is a cardiovascular exercise performed on an elliptical machine. It simulates a walking or running motion with low impact on the joints, making it suitable for a wide range of fitness levels. The exercise targets the cardiovascular system while also engaging the quadriceps, hamstrings, glutes, and calves.

name: ski ergometer
instructions: Stand facing the SkiErg with your feet hip-width apart.
Grab a handle in each hand with your arms extended overhead.
Pull the handles down in an arc, hinging at the hips and bending the knees slightly as your hands pass your face.
Finish with your hands by your thighs and your torso leaning forward.
Stand back up and let your arms return overhead with control.
Keep a steady rhythm, driving each pull with your lats, triceps and core.
Continue for the desired duration or number of repetitions.
description: The ski ergometer exercise targets the triceps and simulates the motion of cross-country skiing using a skierg machine. It also engages the shoulders and forearms, providing a cardiovascular and strength workout.

name: dumbbell standing around world
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a dumbbell in each hand.
Start with the dumbbells in front of your thighs, arms straight.
Keeping your arms straight, raise the dumbbells out to the sides in a wide arc until they meet overhead.
Continue the circular motion, bringing the dumbbells back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell standing around world is a shoulder exercise that involves moving dumbbells in a circular motion around the body, targeting the deltoids and engaging the triceps and forearms.

name: cable seated chest press
instructions: Adjust the seat height and cable handles to a comfortable position.
Sit on the bench with your back straight and feet flat on the floor.
Grasp the cable handles with an overhand grip at shoulder height.
Push the handles forward and away from your body, extending your arms fully.
Pause for a moment, then slowly bring the handles back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The cable seated chest press is a resistance exercise targeting the pectoral muscles using a cable machine. It also engages the shoulders and triceps as secondary muscles. The movement is performed while seated, pressing the cable handles forward and then returning to the starting position.

name: ez barbell decline triceps extension
instructions: Lie on a decline bench with your head lower than your feet and your feet secured.
Hold the ez barbell with an overhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart.
Extend your arms fully, keeping your elbows close to your head.
Lower the barbell slowly towards your forehead, bending your elbows.
Pause for a moment, then extend your arms back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The EZ barbell decline triceps extension is an isolation exercise targeting the triceps, performed on a decline bench using an EZ bar. It requires good control and technique to avoid injury, especially to the elbows and shoulders.

name: barbell reverse close-grip bench press
instructions: Lie flat on a bench with your feet flat on the ground and your back pressed against the bench.
Grasp the barbell with a reverse grip, hands shoulder-width apart.
Lift the barbell off the rack and hold it directly above your chest with your arms fully extended.
Slowly lower the barbell down towards your chest, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Pause for a moment when the barbell is just above your chest.
Push the barbell back up to the starting position, fully extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The barbell reverse close-grip bench press is a compound exercise that targets the triceps, with secondary emphasis on the chest and shoulders. It involves lying on a bench and pressing a barbell with a reverse (underhand) grip, which shifts more focus to the triceps compared to a traditional bench press.

name: dumbbell seated triceps extension
instructions: Sit on a bench with your back straight and feet flat on the ground.
Hold a dumbbell with both hands and extend your arms straight up overhead.
Bend your elbows and lower the dumbbell behind your head, keeping your upper arms close to your ears.
Pause for a moment, then straighten your arms and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell seated triceps extension is an isolation exercise that targets the triceps, performed while seated and using a dumbbell held with both hands overhead.

name: dumbbells seated triceps extension
instructions: Sit on a bench with your back straight and feet flat on the ground.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand and raise them above your head.
Bend your elbows and lower the dumbbells behind your head, keeping your upper arms close to your ears.
Extend your arms and raise the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbells seated triceps extension is an isolation exercise targeting the triceps, performed while seated with a dumbbell held overhead. It is effective for building triceps strength and size.

name: roller hip stretch
instructions: Lie face down and place a foam roller under the front of one hip.
Support your upper body on your forearms.
Keep that leg extended and bend the other leg out to the side for support.
Slowly roll back and forth from the hip to the upper thigh.
Pause on any tight spot and breathe.
Continue for 30-60 seconds.
Switch sides and repeat.
description: The roller hip stretch is a foam roller mobility exercise for the front of the hip: lying face down on your forearms, you roll the front of one hip and thigh over the roller with the other leg bent out to the side.

name: roller seated shoulder flexor depresor retractor
instructions: Sit on the floor with a foam roller under your thighs and your legs extended.
Place your hands on the floor behind you, fingers pointing back, arms straight.
Keeping your arms straight and your shoulders down, slide your body forward over the roller.
Pause when you feel a stretch in the front of your shoulders.
Slide back to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The roller seated shoulder flexor depresor retractor is a seated shoulder mobility exercise: with a roller under your thighs and your hands on the floor behind you, you slide your body forward and back over the roller, opening the shoulders and working the shoulder blades.

name: roller body saw
instructions: Get into a forearm plank with your elbows under your shoulders and a roller under your shins.
Brace your core so your body forms a straight line.
Push through your forearms to slide your body backward over the roller, then pull forward past your elbows.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The roller body saw is a core exercise performed in a forearm plank with a roller under your shins, rocking your body forward and back. It targets the abs and also engages the shoulders and overall core stability.

name: roller hip lat stretch
instructions: Lie on your side with a foam roller under your outer hip, supporting yourself on your forearm.
Cross your top leg over and place that foot flat on the floor in front of you.
Slowly roll back and forth over the outer hip and upper thigh.
Pause on tight spots and breathe.
Continue for 30-60 seconds, then switch sides.
description: The roller hip lat stretch is a foam roller mobility exercise for the outer hip: lying on your side over the roller, you roll the outer hip while the top leg crosses over for support.

name: roller reverse crunch
instructions: Sit on the floor leaning back on your hands, with a roller under your calves and legs extended.
Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Bend your knees and draw them toward your chest, rolling the roller toward you.
Slowly extend your legs to roll it back out.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The roller reverse crunch is an abdominal exercise performed seated, leaning back on your hands with a roller under your calves: you pull the roller toward you by bending your knees and drawing them to your chest, then extend. It targets the abs and hip flexors.

name: roller side lat stretch
instructions: Lie on your side with a foam roller under your outer thigh, supporting yourself on your forearm.
Stack your legs or cross the top foot in front for support.
Slowly roll from just above the knee to the hip.
Pause on tight spots and breathe.
Continue for 30-60 seconds, then switch sides.
description: The roller side lat stretch is a foam roller exercise performed lying on your side, rolling the outer thigh and side of the hip over the roller.

name: roller back stretch
instructions: Kneel on the floor with a foam roller in front of you.
Place your hands or forearms on the roller.
Sit your hips back toward your heels as you roll the roller forward.
Let your chest sink toward the floor and hold the stretch for a few breaths.
Roll the roller back toward you to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The roller back stretch is a mobility exercise: from your knees, you roll a foam roller forward with your hands and sit your hips back toward your heels, stretching the back and lats.

name: roller seated single leg shoulder flexor depresor retractor
instructions: Sit on the floor with one leg extended on a foam roller and the other knee bent, foot flat on the floor.
Place your hands on the floor behind you, fingers pointing back, arms straight.
Keeping your arms straight and your shoulders down, slide your body forward over the roller.
Pause when you feel a stretch in the front of your shoulders.
Slide back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.
description: A seated shoulder mobility exercise: with one leg on a roller, the other knee bent and your hands on the floor behind you, you slide your body forward and back, opening the shoulders and working the shoulder blades.

name: left hook (boxing)
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your knees slightly bent.
Keep your left hand up to protect your face and your right hand by your chin.
Rotate your hips and pivot on your left foot as you swing your left arm in a horizontal arc, elbow bent at about 90 degrees.
Twist your torso and engage your core muscles to generate power in the punch.
Snap your arm back to the starting position and repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The left hook in boxing is a bodyweight exercise that targets the deltoids and involves a rotational punching motion. It also engages the biceps, triceps, and forearms, and requires coordination, balance, and core engagement.

name: lever pullover
instructions: Adjust the seat and handles of the leverage machine to a comfortable position.
Sit on the machine with your back against the pad and grasp the handles with an overhand grip.
Keep your arms slightly bent and your core engaged.
Slowly pull the handles towards your chest, squeezing your lats.
Pause for a moment at the peak contraction, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The lever pullover is a machine-based exercise targeting the latissimus dorsi (lats) and also engaging the triceps and shoulders. It is performed by sitting on a leverage machine, grasping the handles, and pulling them towards the chest in a controlled motion.

name: lever hip extension v. 2
instructions: Kneel on the machine with your forearms or hands on the supports and one foot against the pad.
Brace your core and keep your back neutral.
Push the pad back and up by extending your hip until your thigh is in line with your body.
Pause, squeezing your glutes, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs.
description: The lever hip extension v. 2 is a machine-based exercise targeting the glutes and hamstrings: kneeling on the machine, you push one leg back against the pad to extend the hip.

name: lever alternate leg press
instructions: Adjust the seat and foot platform of the leverage machine to your desired position.
Sit on the machine with your back against the backrest and your feet on the foot platform.
Place your hands on the handles or sides of the machine for stability.
Push one foot against the foot platform, extending your leg until it is almost fully straight.
Pause for a moment, then slowly bend your leg and return to the starting position.
Repeat with the other leg.
Continue alternating legs for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The lever alternate leg press is a machine-based exercise targeting the quadriceps, with secondary emphasis on the hamstrings and glutes. It involves pressing one leg at a time against a foot platform, providing a controlled environment for building lower body strength.

name: lever gripper hands
instructions: Adjust the seat height and grip the handles of the leverage machine.
Keep your back straight and your feet flat on the ground.
Exhale and squeeze the handles, contracting your forearms.
Hold the contraction for a second, then slowly release and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The lever gripper hands exercise targets the forearms using a leverage machine. It involves gripping and squeezing the handles to strengthen the forearm muscles, with secondary activation of the biceps and triceps.

name: lever calf press
instructions: Sit in the machine with your back against the backrest and adjust it so your knees are almost straight with your feet on the platform.
Place the balls of your feet on the lower edge of the platform, with your heels hanging off.
Grasp the handles or side supports for stability.
Push the platform forward by extending your ankles, contracting your calf muscles.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement.
Slowly return to the starting position by letting your heels come back toward you.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The lever calf press is a machine-based exercise targeting the calf muscles. Seated in a reclined position, you press a footplate forward with the balls of your feet while the heels hang off the edge, focusing on ankle extension to contract the calves.

name: dumbbell rear delt raise
instructions: Stand upright with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Keep your chest up and your core engaged.
Bend your elbows and pull them back and out until the dumbbells reach waist level.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together, then slowly lower to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell rear delt raise is performed standing upright, pulling the dumbbells back and out with bent elbows to target the rear deltoids, trapezius and rhomboids.

name: dumbbell standing zottman preacher curl
instructions: Stand up straight holding a dumbbell in one hand, palm facing up.
Place your upper arm against the preacher pad and keep your elbow slightly bent.
Curl the dumbbell up toward your shoulder while keeping your upper arm stationary.
At the top of the movement, rotate your wrist so that your palm faces downward.
Slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position, rotating your wrist back as well.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms.
description: The dumbbell standing Zottman preacher curl is a biceps-focused exercise that also targets the forearms. It combines the preacher curl with a wrist rotation at the top of the movement to emphasize both the biceps and forearm muscles.

name: dumbbell zottman preacher curl
instructions: Sit on a preacher bench with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing up and elbows resting on the pad.
Curl the dumbbells up towards your shoulders, keeping your upper arms stationary and your palms facing up.
At the top of the curl, rotate your wrists so that your palms are facing down.
Slowly lower the dumbbells back down to the starting position, rotating your wrists back to the starting position as you do so.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell Zottman preacher curl is an isolation exercise that targets the biceps and forearms. It combines a standard preacher curl with a wrist rotation at the top, emphasizing both the biceps during the curl and the forearms during the lowering phase.

name: stability ball crunch (full range hands behind head)
instructions: Lie back on the stability ball with your lower back supported, feet flat on the ground and knees bent at 90 degrees.
Place your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing outwards.
Engaging your abs, slowly curl your upper body forward, bringing your chest towards your knees.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your upper body back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The stability ball crunch (full range hands behind head) is an abdominal exercise performed on a stability ball, targeting the abs and engaging the hip flexors as secondary muscles. The movement requires core engagement and balance to execute the crunch through a full range of motion while maintaining stability on the ball.

name: inverted row on bench
instructions: Set a bar in a Smith machine or rack at about arm's length above the floor and place a bench in front of it.
Lie under the bar and grab it with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width.
Place your heels on the bench so your body is straight and elevated.
Pull your chest toward the bar, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause at the top.
Slowly lower yourself until your arms are fully extended.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The inverted row on bench is a bodyweight exercise targeting the upper back: with your feet up on a bench, you hang under a fixed bar and pull your chest to it.

name: inverted row bent knees
instructions: Set up a bar at waist height and lie underneath it.
Grab the bar with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Bend your knees to about 90 degrees with your feet flat on the floor, keeping your hips in line with your torso.
Pull your chest up towards the bar by squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The inverted row with bent knees is a bodyweight exercise targeting the upper back. It involves pulling your chest towards a bar while keeping your body straight and your knees bent, making it more accessible than the straight-leg version.

name: walking on stepmill
instructions: Adjust the stepmill machine to a comfortable level.
Step onto the machine and place your hands on the handrails for support.
Start walking by placing one foot on a step and then the other, alternating between legs.
Maintain an upright posture and engage your core muscles.
Continue walking for the desired duration or distance.
Gradually increase the intensity or speed as you become more comfortable with the exercise.
Remember to cool down and stretch after completing the exercise.
description: Walking on a stepmill is a cardiovascular exercise performed on a machine that simulates stair climbing. It primarily targets the cardiovascular system while also engaging the lower body muscles.

name: lying elbow to knee
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Place your hands behind your head with your elbows pointing outwards.
Engage your abs and lift your upper body off the ground, bringing your right elbow towards your left knee.
At the same time, lift your left knee toward your right elbow, keeping your right foot on the ground.
Pause for a moment, then return to the starting position.
Repeat the movement, this time bringing your left elbow toward your right knee while your left foot stays on the ground.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The lying elbow to knee is a bodyweight abdominal exercise that targets the abs, with secondary emphasis on the hip flexors and lower back. It involves alternating elbow-to-knee movements while lying on your back, engaging the core and promoting coordination.

name: lever rotary calf
instructions: Adjust the seat height so that your knees are slightly bent and your feet are flat on the footplate.
Place your toes on the footplate, with your heels hanging off the edge.
Grasp the handles or the sides of the machine for stability.
Push through the balls of your feet, raising your heels as high as possible.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your heels back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The lever rotary calf exercise targets the calves using a leverage machine. It involves raising and lowering the heels while seated, focusing on the calf muscles and ankle stabilizers.

name: dumbbell seated bent arm lateral raise
instructions: Sit on the end of a bench with your feet flat on the ground and lean your torso forward slightly.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand hanging beside your legs, palms facing in and elbows slightly bent.
Keeping that slight bend, raise your arms out to the sides until they are about parallel to the ground.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your arms back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell seated bent arm lateral raise targets the deltoid muscles in the shoulders, with secondary emphasis on the trapezius and rhomboids. It is performed while seated, which helps stabilize the body and focus the effort on the shoulders.

name: lever shoulder press v. 3
instructions: Adjust the seat height and backrest of the leverage machine to a comfortable position.
Sit on the machine with your back against the backrest and your feet flat on the floor.
Grasp the handles of the machine with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Push the handles upward and forward until your arms are fully extended, but not locked.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the handles back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The lever shoulder press v. 3 is a machine-based exercise targeting the deltoid muscles of the shoulders. It also engages the triceps and chest as secondary muscles. The movement involves pressing handles upward and forward while seated, providing a stable and controlled environment for developing shoulder strength.

name: dumbbell standing inner biceps curl v. 2
instructions: Stand up straight with a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing your torso.
Keep your elbows close to your torso and rotate the palms of your hands until they are facing forward.
While holding your upper arms stationary, curl the weights while contracting your biceps.
Continue to raise the weights until your biceps are fully contracted and the dumbbells are at shoulder level.
Hold the contracted position for a brief pause as you squeeze your biceps.
Slowly begin to bring the dumbbells back to the starting position as your breathe in.
Repeat for the recommended amount of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell standing inner biceps curl v. 2 is a strength exercise that targets the biceps, with secondary emphasis on the forearms. It involves curling dumbbells while standing, focusing on strict form and biceps contraction.

name: dumbbell reverse grip row (female)
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and knees slightly bent.
Hold a dumbbell in each hand with an overhand grip, palms facing your body.
Bend forward at the waist, keeping your back straight and your core engaged.
Let your arms hang straight down, fully extended, with a slight bend in your elbows.
Pull the dumbbells up towards your chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbells back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell reverse grip row is a strength exercise targeting the upper back, performed with dumbbells and a reverse (underhand) grip. It also engages the biceps and forearms.

name: narrow push-up on exercise ball
instructions: Place your hands close together on the floor under your chest and rest your shins or feet on an exercise ball behind you.
Keep your body in a straight line from head to feet.
Lower your chest toward the floor, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Push through your palms to straighten your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The narrow push-up on an exercise ball is performed with your feet on the ball and your hands close together on the floor. It targets the triceps while also engaging the chest and shoulders, and the ball increases the core and balance demand.

name: spine twist
instructions: Sit on the ground with your legs extended in front of you, feet together.
Sit up tall with your back straight.
Fold your arms in front of your chest at shoulder height.
Engage your abs and slowly twist your torso to the right.
Pause for a moment at the end of the twist, then slowly return to the center.
Repeat the twist to the left side.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The spine twist is a bodyweight exercise that targets the abs, obliques and lower back. It involves sitting on the ground with the legs extended and arms in front, and twisting the torso side to side to improve core strength and mobility.

name: cable lat pulldown full range of motion
instructions: Set both pulleys high and grab a handle in each hand.
Stand in the middle with your feet shoulder-width apart and arms extended up and out.
Brace your core and keep your chest up.
Pull the handles down and in an arc until your hands reach your hips.
Pause, squeezing your lats, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The cable lat pulldown full range of motion is performed standing between two high pulleys, pulling the handles down and in an arc to your hips to work the lats through a full range of motion. It also engages the biceps, rhomboids and rear deltoids.

name: cycle cross trainer
instructions: Adjust the seat height and position yourself on the cycle cross trainer.
Place your feet on the pedals and grip the handlebars.
Start pedaling in a smooth and controlled motion.
Maintain a steady pace and increase the resistance if desired.
Continue pedaling for the desired duration of your cardio workout.
description: The cycle cross trainer is a cardiovascular exercise performed on a leverage machine, targeting the cardiovascular system while also engaging the quadriceps, hamstrings, and glutes. It is performed by pedaling in a smooth and controlled motion, with adjustable resistance for varying intensity.

name: arm slingers hanging straight legs
instructions: Place your upper arms in ab straps attached to a pull-up bar, elbows bent at about 90 degrees, legs hanging straight down.
Engage your core and lift your straight legs up in front of you, as high as your face if you can.
Hold for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The arm slingers hanging straight legs exercise involves hanging from a pull-up bar and lifting your straight legs up in front of you, targeting the abdominal muscles while also engaging the shoulders and back.

name: sled lying calf press
instructions: Adjust the sled machine to a comfortable weight.
Lie on your back on the sled machine with your back against the pad and your feet on the platform above you.
Place your toes and the balls of your feet on the edge of the platform, with your heels hanging off.
Push the platform away from you by extending your ankles, keeping your knees slightly bent.
Continue pushing until your calves are fully contracted.
Hold the contraction for a moment, then slowly lower the platform back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The sled lying calf press is a machine-based exercise targeting the calves, performed by pressing a weighted sled away using the balls of the feet while lying on the machine.

name: lever seated calf press
instructions: Sit in the machine with your back against the backrest and adjust it so your knees are almost straight with your feet on the platform.
Place the balls of your feet on the lower edge of the platform, with your heels hanging off.
Grasp the handles on the sides of the seat for stability.
Push the platform forward by extending your ankles as far as possible.
Pause for a moment at the end of the movement, then slowly let your heels come back toward you.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The lever seated calf press is a machine-based exercise targeting the calf muscles. Seated in a reclined position, you press a footplate forward with the balls of your feet, focusing on ankle extension to work the calves.

name: arm slingers hanging bent knee legs
instructions: Place your upper arms in ab straps attached to a pull-up bar, elbows bent, legs hanging straight down.
Engage your core and lift your knees towards your chest, bringing them as close to your elbows as possible.
Slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The arm slingers hanging bent knee legs exercise targets the abdominal muscles by requiring you to hang from a pull-up bar and lift your knees towards your chest. This movement also engages the shoulders and back for stabilization.

name: wide-grip chest dip on high parallel bars
instructions: Position yourself on the parallel bars with your arms fully extended and your body suspended in the air.
Lean forward slightly and lower your body by bending your elbows until your chest is just above the bars.
Pause for a moment, then push yourself back up to the starting position by straightening your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The wide-grip chest dip on high parallel bars is a bodyweight exercise that targets the pectoral muscles, with secondary emphasis on the triceps and shoulders. It requires significant upper body strength, stability, and control, as well as experience with dip movements.

name: assisted wide-grip chest dip (kneeling)
instructions: Adjust the machine to your desired height and secure your knees on the pad.
Grasp the handles with a wide grip and keep your elbows slightly bent.
Lower your body by bending your elbows until your upper arms are parallel to the floor.
Push yourself back up to the starting position by extending your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The assisted wide-grip chest dip (kneeling) is a machine-based exercise targeting the pectorals, with secondary emphasis on the triceps and shoulders. The assistance from the machine makes it accessible for those who may not yet have the strength for unassisted dips.

name: split squats
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Take a step forward with one foot and place it about two feet in front of the other foot.
Lower your body by bending your knees and hips, keeping your back straight.
Continue lowering until your front thigh is parallel to the ground, and your back knee is hovering just above the ground.
Pause for a moment, then push through your front heel to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch legs and repeat.
description: Split squats are a lower body exercise that primarily targets the quadriceps, while also engaging the glutes, hamstrings, and calves. This bodyweight movement involves stepping forward into a split stance and lowering the body until the front thigh is parallel to the ground, then returning to the starting position.

name: weighted russian twist v. 2
instructions: Sit on the floor or a decline bench and hook your feet under a pad, knees bent.
Hold a weight plate with both hands at arm's length in front of you.
Lean back slightly to engage your core muscles.
Twist your torso to the right, bringing the weight towards the right side of your body.
Pause for a moment, then twist your torso to the left, bringing the weight towards the left side of your body.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The weighted Russian twist v.2 is a core exercise that targets the abdominal muscles, particularly the obliques, by incorporating rotational movement with added resistance. It requires balance, coordination, and core strength.

name: dumbbell scott press
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and a dumbbell in each hand, palms facing forward.
Raise the dumbbells to shoulder height, with your elbows bent and palms facing forward.
Press the dumbbells upward until your arms are fully extended.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbells back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The dumbbell Scott press is a shoulder exercise performed standing, pressing dumbbells overhead to target the deltoid muscles.

name: close-grip push-up (on knees)
instructions: Start on your hands and knees, with your hands close together under your chest and your knees hip-width apart.
Lower your upper body towards the ground by bending your elbows, keeping them close to your sides.
Pause for a moment when your chest is just above the ground.
Push through your palms to straighten your arms and return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The close-grip push-up (on knees) is a bodyweight exercise that primarily targets the triceps, with secondary emphasis on the chest and shoulders. It is performed from a kneeling position, making it more accessible for beginners and those building upper body strength.

name: cable seated twist
instructions: Sit on a cable machine with your feet flat on the ground and your knees slightly bent.
Hold the cable handle with both hands and extend your arms straight in front of you.
Keeping your core engaged, slowly rotate your torso to one side, pulling the cable across your body.
Pause for a moment at the end of the range of motion, then slowly rotate back to the starting position.
Repeat on the other side.
Continue alternating sides for the desired number of repetitions.
description: The cable seated twist is an exercise targeting the abdominal muscles, particularly the obliques, using a cable machine. It involves rotating the torso while seated, providing resistance throughout the movement.

name: inverse leg curl (on pull-up cable machine)
